title.en: Volume 310 Biographies 97: Qi Sulei, Ji Ceng Yun, Ji Huang, Gao Bin, Gao Jin, Wan Yan Wei, Gu Cong, Bai Zhongshan
title.raw: 卷310 列傳九十七 齐苏勒 嵇曾筠 嵇璜 高斌 高晋 完颜伟 顾琮 白鍾山

sentences.zh: 列傳九十七

translations.literal: Biographies 97
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 97

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒嵇曾筠子璜高斌從子高晉完顏偉顧琮白鍾山

translations.literal: Qi Sulei, Ji Cengyun, Ji Huang, Gao Bin, Gao Jin, Wan Yanwei, Gu Cong, Bai Zhongshan
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei, Ji Cengyun, Ji Huang, Gao Bin, Gao Jin, Wan Yanwei, Gu Cong, and Bai Zhongshan

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒，字篤之，納喇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei, courtesy name Duzhi, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei, whose courtesy name was Duzhi, belonged to the Nara clan and was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自官學選天文生為欽天監博士，遷靈臺郎。

translations.literal: Selected from the Imperial Academy as an astronomy student, he became a doctor of the Directorate of Astronomy and was transferred to be an officer of the Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen from the Imperial Academy as a student of astronomy, he was appointed doctor of the Directorate of Astronomy and later promoted to an officer of the Observatory.

sentences.zh: 擢內務府主事，授永定河分司。

translations.literal: He was promoted to director of the Imperial Household Department and appointed sub-director of the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to a directorship in the Imperial Household Department and was given charge of the Yongding River as sub-director.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十二年，聖祖南巡閱河，齊蘇勒扈蹕。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Kangxi, when the Sacred Ancestor made a southern tour to inspect the rivers, Qi Sulei attended in the imperial retinue.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 42, when the Kangxi Emperor toured the south to inspect the waterways, Qi Sulei accompanied the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 至淮安，上諭黃河險要處應下挑水埽壩，命往煙墩、九里岡、龍窩修築。

translations.literal: Upon reaching Huai'an, the emperor ordered that at critical points on the Yellow River brush-dams and revetments should be placed, and commanded him to go to Yandun, Jiuligang, and Longwo to build them.
translations.idiomatic: At Huai'an the emperor directed that brush revetments and dams be set at the Yellow River's most dangerous stretches, and sent him to build works at Yandun, Jiuligang, and Longwo.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒於回鑾前畢工，上嘉之。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei completed the work before the return of the imperial carriage, and the emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei finished the projects before the court headed home, and the emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 洊擢翰林院侍講、國子監祭酒，仍領永定河分司事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academy expositor and chancellor of the Imperial Academy, while still overseeing the Yongding River sub-directorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in turn to expositor of the Hanlin Academy and chancellor of the Imperial Academy, yet continued to direct the Yongding River office.

sentences.zh: 河決武陟，奉命同副都御史牛鈕監修堤工。

translations.literal: When the river broke at Wuzhi, he was ordered, together with Vice Censor-in-chief Niu Niu, to supervise repair of the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: After a breach at Wuzhi, he was ordered to supervise dike repairs alongside Vice Censor-in-chief Niu Niu.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「自沁河堤頭至滎澤大堤十八里，擇平衍處築遙堤。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "From the head of the Qin River dike to the great dike at Xingze, a distance of eighteen li, choose level ground and build a distant dike."
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he wrote: "From the head of the Qin River embankment to the great dike at Xingze—eighteen li in all—level ground should be chosen and a setback dike built."

sentences.zh: 使河水趨一道，專力刷深，不致旁溢。

translations.literal: Cause the river water to run in a single channel, concentrate force to scour it deeper, and prevent overflow to the sides.
translations.idiomatic: The current should be confined to one course so its full force could scour the bed deeper and keep the water from spilling sideways.

sentences.zh: 」六十一年，世宗即位，擢山東按察使，兼理運河事。

translations.literal: " In the sixty-first year, when Emperor Shizong acceded, he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shandong and given charge of Grand Canal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixty-first year of Kangxi, when the Yongzheng Emperor came to the throne, Qi Sulei was made surveillance commissioner of Shandong and put in charge of the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 命先往河南籌辦黃河堤工。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go first to Henan to plan Yellow River dike works.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent ahead to Henan to organize Yellow River dike projects.

sentences.zh: 時河南巡撫楊宗義請於馬營口南舊有河形處濬引河。

translations.literal: At that time Henan governor Yang Zongyi proposed dredging a diversion channel where an old river course lay south of Mayingkou.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan governor Yang Zongyi then proposed opening a diversion where an old channel still showed south of Mayingkou.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒同河道總督陳鵬年疏言：「河不兩行，此洩則彼淤。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei, together with Director-general of Rivers Chen Pengnian, memorialized: "A river cannot run in two courses; if it drains here, it silts there."
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei and Director-general of Rivers Chen Pengnian replied: "The Yellow River cannot be made to run in two channels—release water in one place and the other course silts up."

sentences.zh: 馬營口堤甫成，若開引河，慮旁洩侵堤。

translations.literal: The dike at Mayingkou has only just been completed; if a diversion is opened, there is fear of lateral seepage undermining the dike."
translations.idiomatic: "The Mayingkou embankment was only just finished; cutting a diversion might let water leak alongside and eat away the dike."

sentences.zh: 」事乃寢。

translations.literal: " The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was set aside.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授河道總督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, he was appointed Director-general of Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he was appointed Director-general of Rivers.

sentences.zh: 既上官，疏言：「治河之道，若瀕危而後圖之，則一丈之險頓成百丈，千金之費糜至萬金。

translations.literal: Upon taking office he memorialized: "The way to govern a river is this: if one waits until it is in peril before acting, a danger of one zhang suddenly becomes one of a hundred zhang, and an expense of a thousand taels is squandered up to ten thousand."
translations.idiomatic: Once in office he wrote: "River control fails when one waits until danger is imminent: a one-zhang risk becomes a hundred-zhang catastrophe, and a thousand-tael outlay balloons to ten thousand."

sentences.zh: 惟先時豫防，庶力省而功易就。

translations.literal: Only by taking preventive measures in advance can effort be saved and the work more easily accomplished."
translations.idiomatic: "Only timely prevention saves labor and makes success easier."

sentences.zh: 」又言：「各堤壩歲久多傾圮，弊在河員廢弛，冒銷帑金。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The various dikes and dams, after many years, have largely collapsed; the evil lies in river officials' laxity and embezzlement of treasury funds."
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Dikes and dams along the line have crumbled after years of neglect; the fault lies with river officials who slacken duty and embezzle state funds."

sentences.zh: 宜嚴立定章示懲勸。

translations.literal: Strict permanent regulations should be established to show punishment and encouragement."
translations.idiomatic: "Permanent rules with real penalties and rewards should be set."

sentences.zh: 」並允行。

translations.literal: " All were approved and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved everything and ordered it implemented.

sentences.zh: 乃週曆黃河、運河，凡堤形高卑闊狹，水勢淺深緩急，皆計裡測量。

translations.literal: He then made a circuit of the Yellow River and Grand Canal, measuring in li every dike's height and breadth and every stretch of water's depth and current, whether slack or swift.
translations.idiomatic: He toured the Yellow River and Grand Canal, measuring every dike's height, width, and profile and every reach's depth and current in li.

sentences.zh: 總河私費，舊取給屬官，歲一萬三千餘金，及年節餽遺，行部供張，齊蘇勒裁革殆盡。

translations.literal: The director-general's private expenses had formerly been drawn from subordinates—more than thirteen thousand taels yearly, plus New Year gifts, supplies for inspection tours, and the like; Qi Sulei cut these almost entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Private expenses of the director-general—over 13,000 taels yearly from subordinates, holiday gifts, and tour provisions—Qi Sulei slashed nearly to nothing.

sentences.zh: 舉劾必當其能否，人皆懍懍奉法。

translations.literal: Promotions and dismissals matched men's ability; all became fearful and observed the law.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions and dismissals matched real ability, and his staff served the regulations in earnest.

sentences.zh: 陽武、祥符、商丘三縣界黃河，北岸有支流三，逼堤繞行五十餘裡；

translations.literal: Where the Yellow River forms the boundary of Yangwu, Xiangfu, and Shangqiu, on the north bank there were three branch streams forcing the dike and winding more than fifty li;
translations.idiomatic: On the north bank where Yangwu, Xiangfu, and Shangqiu meet the river, three branch streams hugged the dike for more than fifty li;

sentences.zh: 南岸青佛寺有支流一，逼堤繞行四十餘裡。

translations.literal: on the south bank at Qingfosi there was one branch stream forcing the dike and winding more than forty li.
translations.idiomatic: on the south bank at Qingfosi a single branch wound along the dike for more than forty li.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒慮刷損大堤，令築壩堵禦，並接築子堤九千二百八十八丈，隔堤七百八十丈。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei, fearing scour damage to the main dike, ordered dams built to block them, and also linked subsidiary dikes totaling 9,288 zhang and partition dikes of 780 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing scour on the main embankment, he had blocking dams built and added subsidiary and partition dikes totaling 9,288 and 780 zhang.

sentences.zh: 又以洪澤湖水弱，慮黃水倒灌，奏築清口兩岸大壩，中留水門，束高清水以抵黃流。

translations.literal: Because Hongze Lake was weak, fearing Yellow River backflow, he memorialized to build great dams on both banks at Qingkou, leaving sluice gates in the center to confine clear water against the yellow current.
translations.idiomatic: With Hongze Lake low and Yellow River water threatening to back up, he proposed great dams at Qingkou with central gates to pin clear lake water against the muddy river.

sentences.zh: 及淮水暢下，壩在波濤中，又慮壩為水蝕，遣員弁駐工，湖漲下埽防壩，黃漲則用混江龍、鐵篦子諸器，駕小舟往來疏濬，不使沙停，水患始緩。

translations.literal: When the Huai discharged freely, the dams stood in the waves; he also feared erosion, so he stationed officers on the works—when the lake rose they laid brush to protect the dams, when the Yellow rose they used scoop dredgers, iron rakes, and the like in small boats to clear silt so sand would not settle, and the water peril eased.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Huai ran freely the dams stood in open water; he posted officers there—laying brush when the lake rose, using scoop dredgers and iron rakes from small boats when the Yellow rose—so silt would not lodge and the crisis eased.

sentences.zh: 詔豫籌山東諸湖蓄洩以利漕運，疏言：「兗州、濟寧境內，如南旺、馬蹋、蜀山、安山、馬場、昭陽、獨山、微山、稀山等湖，皆運道資以蓄洩，昔人謂之'水櫃'。

translations.literal: An edict ordered planning storage and release in Shandong's lakes to aid the grain transport; he memorialized: "Within Yanzhou and Jining, lakes such as Nanwang, Mata, Shushan, Anshan, Machang, Zhaoyang, Dushan, Weishan, Xishan, and the like all serve the transport route for storage and release; the ancients called them 'water cabinets.'"
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to plan how Shandong's lakes could store and release water for the grain fleet, he listed Nanwang, Mata, Shushan, and other lakes in Yanzhou and Jining—the "water cabinets" of old—on which the canal depended.

sentences.zh: 民乘涸佔種，湖身漸狹。

translations.literal: When the water fell the people seized dry land to plant; the lake beds grew narrower.
translations.idiomatic: People planted on exposed lake bed as waters fell, narrowing the basins.

sentences.zh: 宜乘水落，除已墾熟田，丈量立界，禁侵越。

translations.literal: When the water is low, land already under cultivation should be excluded, boundaries surveyed and fixed, and encroachment forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: After drawdown, already cultivated fields should be surveyed, boundaries marked, and further encroachment barred.

sentences.zh: 謹渟蓄：當運河盛漲，引水使與湖平，即築堰截堵；

translations.literal: " On careful impoundment: when the canal is in full flood, lead water in until it levels with the lakes, then build weirs to block;
translations.idiomatic: "For storage: when the canal floods, channel water until it matches the lakes, then dam the inflow;

sentences.zh: 如遇水淺，則引之從高下注諸湖。

translations.literal: if the water is shallow, then lead it from higher to lower into the various lakes.
translations.idiomatic: when water is low, divert it downhill into the lakes.

sentences.zh: 或宜堤，或宜樹，或宜建閘啟閉，令諸州縣量事程功，則湖水深廣，漕艘無阻矣。

translations.literal: Where dikes suit, plant trees, or build sluices to open and close—let each prefecture and county measure the work—then the lake water will be deep and broad and grain boats unimpeded."
translations.idiomatic: Where dikes, trees, or sluice gates are needed, let each district plan accordingly, and the lakes will hold enough depth for the grain boats."

sentences.zh: 二年，廣西巡撫李紱入對，上諭及淮、揚運河淤墊年久，水高於城，危險可慮。

translations.literal: In the second year, Guangxi governor Li Fu came to audience; the emperor spoke of the Huai-Yang canal's long silting, water standing higher than the cities—a matter of real danger.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, Guangxi governor Li Fu was received in audience; the emperor noted the Huai-Yang canal's decades of silt, with water standing above the towns—a grave risk.

sentences.zh: 紱請於運河西別濬新河，以其土築西堤；

translations.literal: Fu proposed dredging a new canal west of the old route and using the spoil to build a western dike;
translations.idiomatic: Li Fu proposed a new channel west of the canal, using the excavated earth for a western embankment;

sentences.zh: 而以舊河身作東堤，東岸當不至潰決。

translations.literal: and using the old river bed as the eastern dike, so the east bank should not breach.
translations.idiomatic: and the old bed as the eastern dike, which he said would keep the east bank from failing.

sentences.zh: 上命與齊蘇勒商度，齊蘇勒奏言：「淮河上接洪澤，下通江口。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered consultation with Qi Sulei; Qi Sulei memorialized: "The Huai River above joins Hongze Lake and below reaches the river mouth."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him to consult Qi Sulei, who replied: "The Huai joins Hongze above and the sea below."

sentences.zh: 西岸臨白馬、寶應、界首諸湖，水勢汪洋無際。

translations.literal: The west bank faces the lakes at Baima, Baoying, Jieshou, and elsewhere; the water stretches boundlessly.
translations.idiomatic: "Its west bank faces Baima, Baoying, Jieshou, and other lakes—an endless sheet of water."

sentences.zh: 若別挑新河，築西堤於湖水中，不惟糜費巨金，抑且大工難就。

translations.literal: If a new canal is cut separately and a western dike built in lake water, not only will vast sums be wasted, but the great work will be hard to finish."
translations.idiomatic: "Cutting a new channel and building a western dike out in the lakes would cost a fortune and might never be finished."

sentences.zh: 」上是其言。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor accepted his view.

sentences.zh: 是秋颶風作，海潮騰踴丈餘。

translations.literal: That autumn a typhoon struck; the sea tide surged more than a zhang.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn a hurricane drove the tide more than a zhang high.

sentences.zh: 黃河入海之路，二水沖激，曆三晝夜，而濱海堤岸屹然。

translations.literal: At the Yellow River's outlet to the sea the two waters clashed for three days and nights, yet the coastal dikes stood firm.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Yellow River meets the sea the two waters hammered each other for three days and nights, yet the coastal dikes held.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其修築堅固，賜孔雀翎，並予拜他喇布勒哈番世職。

translations.literal: The emperor praised the solidity of his construction, bestowed a peacock feather, and granted a hereditary rank of Baitalabulehan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his solid work, gave him a peacock feather, and granted a hereditary Baitalabulehan rank.

sentences.zh: 三年，副總河嵇曾筠奏於祥符縣回回寨濬引河，事將竣，齊蘇勒奉命偕總督田文鏡察視。

translations.literal: In the third year, Vice Director-general Ji Cengyun memorialized on dredging a diversion at Huihuizhai in Xiangfu; as the work neared completion, Qi Sulei was ordered with Governor Tian Wenjing to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, Vice Director-general Ji Cengyun reported dredging a diversion at Huihuizhai in Xiangfu; near completion Qi Sulei was sent with Governor Tian Wenjing to inspect.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒奏言：「濬引河必上口正對頂沖，而下口有建瓴之勢，乃能吸大溜入新河，藉其水力滌刷寬深。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei memorialized: "In dredging a diversion the upper mouth must face the main current head-on and the lower mouth must have a pouring-over gradient, so the main torrent can be drawn into the new channel and its force scour it wide and deep."
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei wrote: "A diversion's upper mouth must meet the main current squarely and its lower mouth drop steeply, so the main flow is sucked in and scours the new bed wider and deeper."

sentences.zh: 今所濬引河，與現在水向不甚相對。

translations.literal: The diversion now dredged does not align well with the present current.
translations.idiomatic: "The channel now cut does not line up with the live current."

sentences.zh: 當移上三十餘丈，對沖迎溜。

translations.literal: The upper mouth should be moved up more than thirty zhang to meet the current head-on.
translations.idiomatic: "Move the upper opening thirty-odd zhang upstream to take the rush head-on."

sentences.zh: 复於對岸建挑水壩，挑溜順行，以對引河之口。

translations.literal: Also build a deflection dam on the opposite bank to turn the current straight toward the diversion mouth.
translations.idiomatic: "Build a deflection dam on the far bank to steer the stream into the new mouth."

sentences.zh: 俟水漲時相機開放，庶河流東注，而南岸堤根可保無虞。

translations.literal: When the water rises, open it as conditions allow, so the river may flow east and the south-bank dike toe be kept safe."
translations.idiomatic: "Open it when floods allow so the river runs east and the south bank stays secure."

sentences.zh: 」上命內閣學士何國宗等以儀器測量，命齊蘇勒會勘。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered Grand Secretariat academician He Guozong and others to measure with instruments and Qi Sulei to join the survey.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered Academician He Guozong and others to survey with instruments and Qi Sulei to join them.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒奏：「儀器測度地勢，於河工高下之宜甚有準則。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei memorialized: "Instrument measurement of terrain gives very reliable standards for what is high or low in river works."
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei said instrument leveling gave reliable standards for river works.

sentences.zh: 今洪澤湖滾水壩舊立門檻太高，不便於洩水。

translations.literal: The old sill of the rolling dam on Hongze Lake is too high and inconvenient for discharging water.
translations.idiomatic: The old sill on Hongze's rolling dam was too high to drain the lake properly.

sentences.zh: 請敕諸臣繞至湖口，用儀器測定，將門檻改低，庶宣防有賴。

translations.literal: He asked that officials be ordered to go around to the lake mouth, measure with instruments, and lower the sill, so flood control may rely on it."
translations.idiomatic: He asked officials to measure at the lake mouth and lower the sill to improve flood control."

sentences.zh: 」又奏言：「治河物料用葦、柳，而柳尤適宜。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "River materials use reed and willow, and willow is especially suitable."
translations.idiomatic: He also urged reeds and willows for river works, especially willow.

sentences.zh: 今飭屬於空閒地種柳，沮洳地種葦。

translations.literal: He now ordered subordinates to plant willow on idle land and reed in marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates were told to plant willows on dry ground and reeds in wetlands.

sentences.zh: 應請凡種柳八千株、葦二頃者，予紀錄一次，著為例。

translations.literal: He requested that whoever plants eight thousand willows or two qing of reed receive one merit record, to be made a regulation."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed merit records for eight thousand willows or two qing of reeds, as a standing rule."

sentences.zh: 」均稱旨。

translations.literal: " All were approved as directed.
translations.idiomatic: " All was approved.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏言：「供應節禮，並已裁革。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized again: "Holiday gifts and supplies have already been cut."
translations.idiomatic: He soon added: "Holiday gifts and perquisites are already abolished."

sentences.zh: 河標四營舊有坐糧，歲千餘金，以之修造墩台，制換衣甲、器械；

translations.literal: The four river-banner camps formerly had sitting grain, more than a thousand taels yearly, used to repair blockhouses and replace armor and weapons;
translations.idiomatic: The four river camps once drew sitting grain of 1,000-odd taels yearly for blockhouses, armor, and arms;

sentences.zh: 鹽商陋規歲二千金，為出操驗兵賞功犒勞之用。

translations.literal: salt merchants' improper levies of two thousand taels yearly served to pay troops on drill, reward merit, and comfort the men.
translations.idiomatic: a salt merchants' levy of 2,000 taels paid drill troops and rewards.

sentences.zh: 每年往來勘估，伏秋兩汛，出駐工次，車馬舟楫，日用所需，拮据實甚。

translations.literal: Each year's tours of inspection, the spring and autumn flood seasons on site, with horses, boats, and daily needs, are in truth very straitened.
translations.idiomatic: Annual inspections and flood-season camps, with horses, boats, and daily costs, left him genuinely pressed.

sentences.zh: 河庫道收額解錢糧，向有隨平餘銀五千餘，除道署日用工食，請恩准支銷。

translations.literal: The river treasury intendant's remitted funds had surplus silver of more than five thousand from scale fees; aside from the intendant's daily expenses, he asked grace to draw on it."
translations.idiomatic: Surplus scale-fee silver of 5,000-odd taels at the river treasury, beyond the intendant's routine costs, he asked leave to spend."

sentences.zh: 」上允之。

translations.literal: " The emperor granted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 四年，以堵築睢寧硃家口決口，加兵部尚書、太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, for blocking the breach at Zhujiakou in Suining, he was made Minister of War and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, for closing the breach at Zhujiakou in Suining, he was made Minister of War and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年，疏言：「黃河鬥岸常患衝激，應改斜坡，俾水隨坡溜，坡上懸密柳抵之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he memorialized: "Yellow River steep banks are often scour-battered; they should be sloped so water runs down the slope, with dense willows hung on the slope to resist it."
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he proposed sloping steep Yellow River banks, with dense willows on the slope to break the current.

sentences.zh: 既久溜入中泓，柳枝霑泥，並成沙灘，則易險為平。

translations.literal: After long current into the channel center, willow branches take mud and together form sand bars, then danger becomes level ground."
translations.idiomatic: "Over time the current centers, willows catch silt, sand bars form, and a hazard becomes a flat beach."

sentences.zh: 」從其請。

translations.literal: " His request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 是年，齊蘇勒有疾，上遣醫往視。

translations.literal: That year Qi Sulei fell ill; the emperor sent a physician to see him.
translations.idiomatic: That year he fell ill and the emperor sent a doctor.

sentences.zh: 尋入覲，命歲支養廉萬金。

translations.literal: Soon he came to court; he was ordered ten thousand taels yearly for integrity nurture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was received at court and granted 10,000 taels yearly as integrity-nurture funds.

sentences.zh: 六年，兩江總督範時繹、江蘇巡撫陳時夏濬吳淞江，上命齊蘇勒料理。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Governors-general Fan Shiyi of Liangjiang and Chen Shixia of Jiangsu dredged the Wusong River; the emperor ordered Qi Sulei to manage it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, Fan Shiyi and Jiangsu governor Chen Shixia dredged the Wusong; the emperor put Qi Sulei in charge.

sentences.zh: 築壩陳家渡，松江知府周中鋐、千總陸章乘舟督工下埽，潮回壩陷，溺焉。

translations.literal: Building a dam at Chenjiadu, Songjiang prefect Zhou Zhongqian and garrison commander Lu Zhang supervised laying brush from boats; the tide returned, the dam collapsed, and they drowned.
translations.idiomatic: At Chenjiadu, Prefect Zhou Zhongqian and Commander Lu Zhang oversaw brush work from boats; the tide turned, the dam failed, and both drowned.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒往視察，下為土埂，中有停沙，因督令疏濬，壩工乃竟。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei went to inspect; below was an earthen ridge with sand trapped within; he ordered dredging, and the dam work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei found an earthen ridge below with trapped sand, ordered dredging, and the dam was finished.

sentences.zh: 复偕曾筠會勘河南雷家寺支河，是秋事畢。

translations.literal: He again joined Cengyun to survey the Leijiasi branch in Henan; that autumn the work was done.
translations.idiomatic: He and Cengyun surveyed the Leijiasi branch in Henan; by autumn that too was done.

sentences.zh: 於是黃河自碭山至海口，運河自邳州至江口，縱橫綿亙三千餘裡，兩岸堤防崇廣若一，河工益完整。

translations.literal: Thus from Dangshan to the sea on the Yellow River and from Pizhou to the river mouth on the canal, more than three thousand li of dikes stood high and broad as one, and river works grew more complete.
translations.idiomatic: From Dangshan to the sea and Pizhou to the river mouth—3,000 li of embankments now uniform in height and breadth—the river system was more complete than ever.

sentences.zh: 七年春，疾甚，上復遣醫往視。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year his illness was severe; the emperor again sent a physician.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 7 his illness worsened and the emperor again sent a doctor.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，賜銀三千兩為歸櫬資，進世職三等阿達哈哈番，賜祭葬，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: Soon he died; three thousand taels were granted for his coffin's return, his hereditary rank was raised to third-grade Adaha Khan, with funeral rites and posthumous name Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after; 3,000 taels were granted for his funeral, his hereditary rank raised to third-grade Adaha Khan, with rites and posthumous name Qinke.

sentences.zh: 上又以靳輔、齊蘇勒實能為國宣勞，有功民社，命尹繼善等擇地，令有司春秋致祭。

translations.literal: The emperor also said that Jin Fu and Qi Sulei had truly labored for the state and benefited the people, and ordered Yin Jishan and others to choose a site for local officials to sacrifice in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Jin Fu and Qi Sulei had truly served the realm and ordered Yin Jishan to choose a site for seasonal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒久任河督，世宗深器之，嘗諭曰：「爾清勤不待言，而獨立不倚，從未聞夤緣結交，尤屬可嘉。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei long served as river director; Emperor Shizong greatly valued him and once instructed: "Your integrity and diligence need not be spoken of; but your standing alone without leaning on others—I have never heard of your currying favor or forming cliques—this is especially praiseworthy."
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng greatly trusted Qi Sulei after his long tenure as river director, telling him: "Your diligence is plain, but that you stand alone and never court factions is especially admirable."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「隆科多、年羹堯作威福，攬權勢。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Longkodo and Nian Gengyao played the tyrant and monopolized power."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Longkodo and Nian Gengyao threw their weight about and hoarded power."

sentences.zh: 隆科多於朕前謂爾操守難信，年羹堯前歲數詆爾不學無術，朕以此知爾獨立也。

translations.literal: Longkodo told me before you that your conduct was untrustworthy; Nian Gengyao for years slandered you as unlearned and incompetent—I knew from this that you stood alone."
translations.idiomatic: "Longkodo told me your integrity was suspect; Nian Gengyao called you unlearned year after year—from that I knew you owed neither of them."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「齊蘇勒歷練老成，清慎勤三字均屬無媿。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Qi Sulei is experienced and mature; the three words clear, cautious, and diligent are all without reproach."
translations.idiomatic: "He also said Qi Sulei was seasoned and without fault on clarity, caution, and diligence."

sentences.zh: 」八年，京師賢良祠成，復命與靳輔同入祀。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year, when the Worthies Shrine in the capital was completed, he was again ordered worshipped together with Jin Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, when the Worthies Shrine was finished, he was enshrined with Jin Fu.

sentences.zh: 嵇曾筠，字松友，江南長洲人。

translations.literal: Ji Cengyun, courtesy name Songyou, was a native of Changzhou in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Cengyun, courtesy name Songyou, came from Changzhou in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 父永仁，諸生，從福建總督范承謨死事；

translations.literal: His father Yongren, a licentiate, followed Fujian Governor-general Fan Chengmo to his death;
translations.idiomatic: His father Yongren, a licentiate, died with Governor-general Fan Chengmo of Fujian;

sentences.zh: 母楊守節，撫曾筠成立：事分見忠義、列女傳中。

translations.literal: his mother Yang kept her chastity and raised Cengyun to maturity: their stories are told separately in the Loyalty and Chaste Women biographies.
translations.idiomatic: his mother Yang remained chaste and raised him—told in the Loyalty and Chaste Women chapters.

sentences.zh: 曾筠，康熙四十五年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: Cengyun, a jinshi of the forty-fifth year of Kangxi, was selected a bachelor and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Cengyun passed the jinshi in Kangxi 45, entered the Hanlin as bachelor, and became a compiler.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍講。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to expositor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to expositor.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，直南書房，兼上書房。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he served in the Southern Study and also the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he served in the Southern and Upper Studies.

sentences.zh: 擢左僉都御史，署河南巡撫，即充鄉試考官。

translations.literal: He was promoted Left Vice Censor-in-chief and acted as Henan governor, and at once served as provincial examiner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Left Vice Censor-in-chief, acted as Henan governor, and served as provincial examiner.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 河決中牟劉家莊、十里店諸地。

translations.literal: The river broke at Liujiazhuang, Shilidian, and other places in Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke at Liujiazhuang, Shilidian, and other sites in Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 詔往督築，逾數月，工竟。

translations.literal: He was ordered to supervise construction; after several months the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to supervise repairs, he finished in a few months.

sentences.zh: 二年春，奏言：「黃、沁並漲，漫溢銚期營、秦家廠、馬營口諸堤。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year he memorialized: "The Yellow and Qin both rose and overflowed the dikes at Yaoqiying, Qinjiachang, Mayingkou, and elsewhere."
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 2 he reported the Yellow and Qin in flood, overtopping dikes at Yaoqiying, Qinjiachang, Mayingkou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 循流審視，窮致患之由。

translations.literal: Following the current he surveyed and fully traced the sources of the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: He traced the current and investigated the causes to the end.

sentences.zh: 見北岸長沙灘，逼水南趨，至倉頭口，繞廣武山根，逶迤屈曲而下。

translations.literal: He saw on the north bank a long sand bar forcing the water south, reaching Cangtoukou, winding around the foot of Guangwu Mountain in serpentine bends.
translations.idiomatic: On the north bank a long sand bar drove the current south to Cangtoukou, where it wound around Guangwu Mountain in serpentine bends.

sentences.zh: 官莊峪又有山嘴外伸，河流由西南直注東北，秦家廠諸地頂沖受險。

translations.literal: At Guanzhuangyu another mountain spur projected; the river ran straight from southwest to northeast, and Qinjiachang and other places bore the full head-on force of danger.
translations.idiomatic: At Guanzhuangyu a spur thrust out; the stream ran southwest to northeast, and Qinjiachang and nearby points took the full brunt.

sentences.zh: 請於倉頭口對面橫灘開引河，俾水勢由西北而東南，毋令激射東北；

translations.literal: He asked that at Cangtoukou opposite the cross bar a diversion be opened, so the water may run from northwest to southeast and not be driven head-on northeast;
translations.idiomatic: He proposed a diversion opposite Cangtoukou across the bar so the current would run northwest to southeast instead of slamming northeast;

sentences.zh: 並培釘船幫大壩，更於上下增築減水壩，秦家廠諸地險勢可減。

translations.literal: and also strengthen the nailed-boat-side great dam, and further build overflow dams above and below, so the danger at Qinjiachang and elsewhere may be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: and strengthen the nailed-boat-side great dam, add overflow dams up- and downstream, and ease the hazard at Qinjiachang.

sentences.zh: 」又與河督齊蘇勒會奏培兩岸堤，北起滎澤，至山東曹縣；

translations.literal: " He also jointly memorialized with Director-general Qi Sulei to strengthen dikes on both banks, from Xingze in the north to Caoxian in Shandong;
translations.idiomatic: " With Director-general Qi Sulei he also proposed strengthening both banks from Xingze north to Caoxian in Shandong;

sentences.zh: 南亦起滎澤，至江南碭山：都計十二萬三千餘丈。

translations.literal: in the south also from Xingze to Dangshan in Jiangnan: in all more than 123,000 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: southward from Xingze to Dangshan in Jiangnan—123,000-odd zhang in all.

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 授河南副總河，駐武陟。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director-general of Henan and stationed at Wuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He became Vice Director-general of Henan, based at Wuzhi.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「鄭州大堤石家橋迤東大溜南趨，應下埽簽椿，复於埽灣建磯嘴壩一。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "At Zhengzhou on the great dike east of Shijiaqiao the main current trends south; brush revetments and piles should be laid, and also a stone spur dam built at the revetment bend."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote that east of Shijiaqiao on Zhengzhou's great dike the main current ran south and needed brush revetments, piles, and a stone spur at the bend.

sentences.zh: 中牟拉牌寨黃流逼射，應下埽護岸，建磯嘴挑水壩二。

translations.literal: At Lapai Village in Zhongmou the yellow current forces the bank; brush should be laid to protect the shore and two stone spurs built to deflect water.
translations.idiomatic: At Lapai in Zhongmou the Yellow River hammered the bank; he called for brush protection and two deflection spurs.

sentences.zh: 穆家樓堤工坐衝，亦應下埽加鑲。

translations.literal: The dike work at Mujialou sits in the direct rush; brush should also be laid and reinforced.
translations.idiomatic: The Mujialou works sat in the main rush and needed brush and reinforcement.

sentences.zh: 陽武北岸祥符珠水、牛趙二處堤工，近因中牟迤下，新長淤灘，大溜北趨成衝，應順埽加鑲。

translations.literal: On the north bank at Xiangfu, Zhushui and Niuzhao dike works, because below Zhongmou a new silt bar has grown and the main current trends north into scour, brush should follow the current and be reinforced.
translations.idiomatic: North of Xiangfu at Zhushui and Niuzhao, new silt below Zhongmou had turned the main current north; brush should follow and reinforce the bank.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「小丹河自辛句口至河內清化鎮水口二千餘裡。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The Xiao Dan River from Xingoukou to the mouth at Qinghua Town in Hanoi is more than two thousand li."
translations.idiomatic: "The Xiao Dan River runs 2,000-odd li from Xingoukou to Qinghua Town in Hanoi."

sentences.zh: 昔人建閘開渠，定三日放水濟漕，一日塞口灌田。

translations.literal: The ancients built sluices and canals, fixing three days to release water for the grain transport and one day to block the mouth for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: "Ancients built sluices: three days' water for the grain fleet, one day blocked for fields."

sentences.zh: 日久閘夫賣水阻運，請嚴飭。

translations.literal: Over time sluice attendants sold water and obstructed transport; strict orders are requested.
translations.idiomatic: "Sluice men now sold water and blocked transport—he asked strict enforcement."

sentences.zh: 仍用官三民一之法，違治其罪。

translations.literal: Still use the method of three parts official and one part private; violators shall be punished."
translations.idiomatic: "Keep the three-official, one-private rule and punish violators."

sentences.zh: 」又言祥符南岸回回寨對面淤灘直出河心，致河勢南趨逼省城。

translations.literal: " He also said that on the south bank at Huihuizhai in Xiangfu the silt bar thrust straight into the river center, causing the current to trend south and press the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: He also said a silt bar at Huihuizhai on Xiangfu's south bank pushed the current south toward the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 請於北岸舊河身濬引河，導水直行。

translations.literal: He asked to dredge a diversion in the old bed on the north bank to lead the water straight.
translations.idiomatic: He asked a north-bank diversion in the old channel to straighten the flow.

sentences.zh: 上諮齊蘇勒用曾筠議。

translations.literal: The emperor consulted Qi Sulei and adopted Cengyun's plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted Qi Sulei and took Cengyun's plan.

sentences.zh: 四年，奏衛河水盛，請於汲、湯陰、內黃、大名諸縣築草壩二十七。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he memorialized that the Wei River was in full flood and asked to build twenty-seven grass dams in Ji, Tangyin, Neihuang, Daming, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he reported the Wei in flood and asked for twenty-seven grass dams in Ji, Tangyin, Neihuang, Daming, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 又請培鄭州薛家集諸處埽壩。

translations.literal: He also asked to strengthen revetments at Xuejiaji in Zhengzhou and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: He also sought stronger revetments at Xuejiaji in Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，命兼管山東黃河堤工。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to oversee Shandong Yellow River dike works as well.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he was put in charge of Shandong Yellow River dikes as well.

sentences.zh: 尋轉吏部侍郎，仍留副總河任。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel, while retaining the vice director-general post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became Vice Minister of Personnel but kept the river post.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏言：「儀封北岸因水勢衝急，雷家寺上首灘崖刷成支河。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he memorialized: "On the north bank at Yifeng, because the current is swift, at the head of Leijiasi the bank was scoured into a branch channel."
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he reported that at Leijiasi on Yifeng's north bank swift water had scoured a branch channel.

sentences.zh: 請將舊堤加幫，接築土壩，跨斷支河，以防掣溜侵堤。

translations.literal: He asked to strengthen the old dike, link earthen dams, and span and cut off the branch to prevent a ripping current from undermining the dike.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed strengthening the old dike, linking earthen dams, and cutting off the branch before it undermined the main embankment.

sentences.zh: 青龍岡水勢縈紆，將上灣淘作深兜，與下灣相對。

translations.literal: At Qinglonggang the current winds; the upper bend is being scoured into a deep pocket opposite the lower bend.
translations.idiomatic: At Qinglonggang the current circled; the upper bend was scouring a deep pocket opposite the lower bend.

sentences.zh: 請乘勢開引河，導水東行。

translations.literal: He asked to take advantage and open a diversion to lead the water east.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to open a diversion and steer the water east.

sentences.zh: 」尋擢兵部尚書，調吏部，仍管副總河事。

translations.literal: " Soon he was promoted Minister of War, transferred to Personnel, and still managed vice director-general affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon he was Minister of War, then Personnel, while still managing river affairs.

sentences.zh: 奏請培蘭陽耿家寨北堤，下埽簽椿築壩。

translations.literal: He memorialized to strengthen the north dike at Gengjiazhai in Lanyang, laying brush, piles, and building dams.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed strengthening Lanyang's north dike at Gengjiazhai with brush, piles, and dams.

sentences.zh: 七年，授河南山東河道總督，疏請開荊隆口引河。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Director-general of Henan and Shandong Rivers and memorialized to open a diversion at Jinglongkou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he became Director-general of Henan and Shandong Rivers and asked to open Jinglongkou diversion.

sentences.zh: 八年，署江南河道總督，疏言：「山水異漲，匯歸駱馬湖，溢運浮黃，河、湖合一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he acted as Director-general of Jiangnan Rivers and memorialized: "Mountain floods rise differently and converge on Luoma Lake; they overflow the canal and float yellow, river and lake becoming one."
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, acting Jiangnan director-general, he wrote that mountain floods poured into Luoma Lake, lifting the canal and mingling river with lake.

sentences.zh: 請於山盱周橋以南開壩洩水，並啟高、寶諸堰，分水入江海。

translations.literal: He asked to open dams south of Zhouqiao in Shanxi to discharge water, and also open the Gaobao and other weirs to divide water into river and sea.
translations.idiomatic: He asked dams south of Zhouqiao on Shan(xi) and opening Gaobao and other weirs to send water to river and sea.

sentences.zh: 高堰山盱石工察有椿腐石欹，順砌卑矮者，應築月壩，加高培實。

translations.literal: On the Gaobao dike at Shanxi stone works were inspected: piles rotted and stones tilted; where the facing was low it should be built as a crescent dam, raised and packed solid.
translations.idiomatic: Stone works on the Gaobao dike at Shanxi had rotten piles and leaning stones; low faces needed crescent dams raised and packed.

sentences.zh: 其年久傾圮者，全行改築。

translations.literal: Where long collapsed, rebuild entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Long-collapsed sections should be rebuilt entirely.

sentences.zh: 興工之際，築壩攔水，留舊石工為障。

translations.literal: When work begins, build dams to hold back water and leave old stonework as a barrier.
translations.idiomatic: During construction, coffer dams should hold water back, leaving old stone as a screen.

sentences.zh: 俟新基築定，再除舊石，仍留舊底二層，以御風浪。

translations.literal: When the new foundation is set, remove the old stone, yet leave two layers of the old base to resist wind and waves.
translations.idiomatic: Once the new base was firm, old stone could come out but two old layers should remain against wind and waves.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「禹王台壩工為江南下游保障。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The Yuwangtai dam works are the safeguard of lower Jiangnan."
translations.idiomatic: He also said the Yuwangtai dam protected lower Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 沭水源長性猛，壩工受衝。

translations.literal: The Shu River source is long and fierce; the dam works bear the rush.
translations.idiomatic: The Shu River ran long and hard; the dam took the impact.

sentences.zh: 請於現有竹絡壩二十七丈外，依頂沖形勢，建石工六百餘丈。

translations.literal: Beyond the existing twenty-seven zhang of bamboo-cage dam, according to the head-on shape, build more than six hundred zhang of stonework.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond twenty-seven zhang of bamboo-cage dam he asked six hundred-odd zhang of stone built to the head-on shape.

sentences.zh: 接連岡阜，仍築土堤，並濬沭河口門，使循故道直趨入海。

translations.literal: Linking the hill ridges, still build earthen dikes, and dredge the Shu River mouth so it runs straight to the sea in its old course.
translations.idiomatic: Link hills with earthen dikes, dredge the Shu mouth, and restore its old course to the sea.

sentences.zh: 」十年，奏揚州芒稻河閘商工草率，改歸官轄，並增設閘官。

translations.literal: " In the tenth year he memorialized that merchant work on the Mangdao River sluice at Yangzhou was slipshod; it should revert to official control and sluice officers be added.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he reported slipshod merchant work on Yangzhou's Mangdao sluice and asked official control with new sluice officers.

sentences.zh: 十二月，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，授文華殿大學士，兼吏部尚書，仍總督江南河道，予一品封典。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eleventh year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory, concurrently Minister of Personnel, still Director-general of Jiangnan Rivers, with first-rank enfeoffment privilege.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 of year 11 he became Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and Minister of Personnel, still river director-general, with first-rank enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丁母憂，命在任守制。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month his mother died; he was ordered to observe mourning in office.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 his mother died; he was ordered to mourn in office.

sentences.zh: 曾筠奏懇回籍終制，溫詔許之。

translations.literal: Cengyun memorialized earnestly to return home to complete mourning; a warm edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Cengyun begged to go home for full mourning and was warmly allowed.

sentences.zh: 以高斌暫署，仍諭曾筠本籍距淮安不遠，明歲工程，就近協同經理。

translations.literal: Gao Bin was temporarily put in charge; Cengyun was still told that his native place was not far from Huai'an and that next year's works he should help manage nearby.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin acted in his place; the court noted his home was near Huai'an and asked him to help with next year's works.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月，同高斌奏增築海口辛家蕩堤閘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year he and Gao Bin jointly memorialized to add dikes and sluices at Xinjiadang on the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 of year 12 he and Gao Bin proposed new estuary dikes and sluices at Xinjiadang.

sentences.zh: 同副總河白鍾山奏修清江龍王閘，濬通鳳陽廠引河。

translations.literal: With Vice Director-general Bai Zhongshan he memorialized repair of the Dragon King sluice at Qingjiang and dredging the Fengyang factory diversion.
translations.idiomatic: With Vice Director-general Bai Zhongshan he repaired Qingjiang's Dragon King sluice and dredged the Fengyang factory channel.

sentences.zh: 十三年，諭曾筠葬母事畢赴工。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to return to the works when his mother's burial was done.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he was told to resume work after his mother's burial.

sentences.zh: 高宗御極，命總理浙江海塘工程。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozong acceded, he was ordered to take overall charge of Zhejiang seawall works.
translations.idiomatic: When Qianlong acceded, he was put in charge of Zhejiang seawalls.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，兼浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he also served as Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he also governed Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 尋命改為總督，兼管鹽政。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered changed to governor-general, with charge of the salt administration.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became governor-general with the salt monopoly.

sentences.zh: 曾筠條奏鹽政，請改商捕為官役，嚴緝私販，定緝私賞罰。

translations.literal: Cengyun memorialized on salt policy, asking to change merchant catchers to official runners, strictly suppress private salt, and fix rewards and penalties for seizure.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed replacing merchant salt catchers with official runners, tightening anti-smuggling, and fixing seizure rewards and penalties.

sentences.zh: 地方有搶鹽奸徒，官吏用盜案例參處。

translations.literal: Where local salt robbers appeared, officials were to punish them under bandit statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Local salt gangs were to be punished under bandit law.

sentences.zh: 又疏請於海寧築尖山壩，建魚鱗石塘七千四百餘丈。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to build the Jianshan dam at Haining and a fish-scale stone seawall of more than 7,400 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for the Jianshan dam at Haining and 7,400-odd zhang of fish-scale stone seawall.

sentences.zh: 入覲，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: On entering audience he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: At audience he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二年，疏請築淳安淳河石磡。

translations.literal: In the second year he memorialized to build the Chunhe stone weir at Chun'an.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he proposed the Chunhe stone weir at Chun'an.

sentences.zh: 三年，疏請修樂清濱海堤；

translations.literal: In the third year he memorialized to repair the coastal dike at Yueqing;
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he asked repairs on Yueqing's coastal dike;

sentences.zh: 又疏請發省城義倉運溫、台諸縣平糶：並從之。

translations.literal: he also memorialized to issue grain from the provincial charity granary for relief sale in Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other counties: all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: and to release provincial charity grain for relief sale in Wen and Tai—all approved.

sentences.zh: 尋召入閣治事，以疾請回籍調治。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned to the Grand Council; on illness he asked to return home for treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered the Grand Council; ill, he asked to go home to recover.

sentences.zh: 上令其子璜歸省，又遣醫診視。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered his son Huang to return to visit him and sent a physician.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent his son Huang home to visit and a physician to treat him.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈少保，賜祭葬，諡文敏，祀浙江賢良祠。

translations.literal: He died; he was posthumously made Junior Guardian, with funeral rites and posthumous name Wenmin, worshipped in the Zhejiang Worthies Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: He died, was posthumously Junior Guardian with posthumous name Wenmin, and enshrined in Zhejiang's Worthies Shrine.

sentences.zh: 又命視靳輔、齊蘇勒例，一體祠祀。

translations.literal: He was also ordered worshipped like Jin Fu and Qi Sulei.
translations.idiomatic: He was also ordered worshipped like Jin Fu and Qi Sulei.

sentences.zh: 曾筠在官，視國事如家事。

translations.literal: In office Cengyun treated state affairs as household affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In office Cengyun treated state business as his own household affairs.

sentences.zh: 知人善任，恭慎廉明，治河尤著績。

translations.literal: He knew men and employed them well; respectful, cautious, honest, and clear; in river governance his achievements were especially notable.
translations.idiomatic: He knew talent, served with respect and integrity, and shone especially in river work.

sentences.zh: 用引河殺險法，前後省庫帑甚鉅。

translations.literal: Using the method of diversion channels to reduce danger, he saved the treasury vast sums before and after.
translations.idiomatic: His diversion method to kill dangerous currents saved the treasury enormous sums.

sentences.zh: 第三子璜，亦由治河有功，官大學士，繼其武。

translations.literal: His third son Huang, also distinguished in river work, rose to Grand Secretary and followed in his footsteps.
translations.idiomatic: His third son Huang, also famed for river work, became Grand Secretary and followed his path.

sentences.zh: 璜，字尚佐。

translations.literal: Huang, courtesy name Shangzuo.
translations.idiomatic: Huang, courtesy name Shangzuo.

sentences.zh: 幼讀禹貢，曰：「禹治水皆自下而上。

translations.literal: As a child he read the Yugong and said: "Yu controlled the waters all from below upward."
translations.idiomatic: As a boy reading the Yugong he said: "Yu controlled floods from downstream upward."

sentences.zh: 蓋下游宣通，水自順流而下。

translations.literal: For when the lower reaches are open, water naturally flows down."
translations.idiomatic: "When the lower course is clear, water runs down by itself."

sentences.zh: 」長老咸驚異。

translations.literal: " The elders were all astonished.
translations.idiomatic: The elders marveled.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，賜舉人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng he was granted juren status.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 he was granted juren status.

sentences.zh: 八年，成進士，選庶吉士，年裁二十。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he passed the jinshi, was selected a bachelor, aged only twenty.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he passed the jinshi, entered the Hanlin as bachelor, aged only twenty.

sentences.zh: 授編修，再遷諭德。

translations.literal: He was appointed compiler and promoted twice to preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: He became compiler and rose twice to preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，命直南書房。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was ordered to the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he entered the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 三年，丁父憂，服闋，擢庶子。

translations.literal: In the third year his father died; after mourning he was promoted sub-expositor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 his father died; after mourning he became sub-expositor.

sentences.zh: 兩歲四遷左僉都御史。

translations.literal: In two years he was promoted four times to Left Vice Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Within two years he rose four ranks to Left Vice Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 九年，奏：「督撫閱兵，祗就趨走應對定將弁能否。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he memorialized: "When governors-general review troops, they judge officers only by running and answering;
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he wrote that governors reviewing troops judged officers only by drill and answers;

sentences.zh: 請近省命大臣，邊省命將軍、副都統，簡閱行伍。

translations.literal: he asked that in nearby provinces ministers be sent, and in border provinces generals and lieutenant-generals, to inspect the ranks."
translations.idiomatic: he asked ministers in nearby provinces and generals on the frontier to inspect troops properly."

sentences.zh: 」是歲令大學士訥親閱河南、山東、江南三省行伍，璜此奏發之也。

translations.literal: " That year Grand Secretary Neqin was ordered to review the ranks of Henan, Shandong, and Jiangnan; Huang's memorial had prompted it.
translations.idiomatic: " That year Grand Secretary Neqin inspected Henan, Shandong, and Jiangnan—Huang's memorial had started it.

sentences.zh: 璜侍曾筠行河，習工事。

translations.literal: Huang accompanied Cengyun on river tours and learned the works.
translations.idiomatic: Huang toured rivers with Cengyun and learned the engineering.

sentences.zh: 奏河工疏築諸事：請浚毛城鋪壩下引河，並於順河集諸地開河引溜，修築黃河岸，留新黃河、韓家堂諸地舊口，洩盛漲，議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized on river dredging and building: asked to dredge the diversion below Maochengpu dam, open diversions at Shunheji and elsewhere to draw the current, repair Yellow River banks, leave old mouths at Xin Huanghe and Hanjiatang to discharge floods—all approved.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dredging below Maochengpu, opening diversions at Shunheji, repairing Yellow River banks, and leaving old mouths at Xin Huanghe and Hanjiatang to spill floods—all approved.

sentences.zh: 授大理寺卿。

translations.literal: He was appointed President of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was made president of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十八年十月，黃、淮並漲。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighteenth year the Yellow and Huai both rose.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 of year 18 the Yellow and Huai both flooded.

sentences.zh: 璜疏請濬銅山以下、清口以上河身，並仿明劉天和製平底方船，用鐵耙疏沙，修補高堰石工、歸仁堤閘，酌复江南境內減水閘壩。

translations.literal: Huang memorialized to dredge the channel from Tongshan below to above Qingkou, and following Ming Liu Tianhe's method make flat-bottom square boats with iron rakes to clear sand, repair Gaobao stonework and Guiren dike sluices, and restore overflow dams in Jiangnan as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Huang asked dredging from Tongshan to Qingkou, flat-bottom boats with iron rakes after Liu Tianhe, Gaobao stone repairs, Guiren sluices, and Jiangnan overflow dams restored.

sentences.zh: 尚書舒赫德等被命視河，奏請派熟諳工程大員董理堤防，因令璜偕工部侍郎德爾敏督修。

translations.literal: Minister Shuhede and others were ordered to inspect the river and memorialized to dispatch experienced officials to direct dikes; Huang was therefore ordered with Vice Minister of Works De Ermin to supervise repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers including Shuhede inspected the river and asked skilled officials; Huang was sent with Vice Minister De Ermin to supervise.

sentences.zh: 璜奏：「高堰工程有磚石之殊，年分有新舊之異。

translations.literal: Huang memorialized: "Gaobao works differ in brick and stone, and in age new and old."
translations.idiomatic: Huang wrote that Gaobao works mixed brick and stone of different ages.

sentences.zh: 今當修砌石工，堤外築攔水壩，並將舊有磚工盡改石工。

translations.literal: Now stonework should be repaired, overflow dams built outside the dike, and all old brick changed to stone.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed stone repairs, outer overflow dams, and replacing all brick with stone.

sentences.zh: 石較磚重，椿木應培增。

translations.literal: Stone is heavier than brick; pile timbers should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Stone outweighed brick; piles must be deepened.

sentences.zh: 舊修石堤用石二進，石後用磚二進，磚與土不相融結，久經風浪，根空基圮，令於磚石後加築灰土三尺，以御沖刷。

translations.literal: Old stone dikes used two courses of stone, two of brick behind; brick and earth did not bond, and after long wind and waves the base hollowed and collapsed; he ordered three chi of lime-earth added behind brick and stone to resist scour.
translations.idiomatic: Old dikes had two stone courses and two brick behind; brick and earth failed to bond; he added three chi of lime-earth behind brick and stone against scour.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「串場河為諸水總匯。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The Chuanchang River is the general confluence of all waters."
translations.idiomatic: He also said the Chuanchang River gathered all waters.

sentences.zh: 請自石閘南更建閘二，並就舊河道疏濬，直達海口。

translations.literal: He asked to build two more sluices south of the stone sluice, and dredge the old channel straight to the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: He asked two new sluices south of the stone gate and the old channel dredged straight to the sea.

sentences.zh: 」十九年，奏：「高堰、高澖、龍門、古溝四處深塘兜灣，請修復草壩。

translations.literal: " In the nineteenth year he memorialized: "At Gaobao, Gaoxi, Longmen, and Gugou four places are deep pockets and bends; grass dams should be restored."
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he asked grass dams restored at Gaobao, Gaoxi, Longmen, and Gugou deep bends.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " All was approved.

sentences.zh: 是年堤工竟，議敘，轉吏部。

translations.literal: That year the dike work was finished; on merit he was transferred to Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: That year the dikes were done; for merit he moved to Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以母病，乞假歸。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, because his mother was ill, he begged leave to return.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 his mother fell ill and he begged leave home.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春，上以璜母病癒，授南河副總河，並諭曰：「璜侍父曾筠久任河工，見聞所及，諳練非難。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year the emperor, because Huang's mother had recovered, appointed him Vice Director-general of the Southern Rivers and instructed: "Huang long attended his father Cengyun in river office; what he has seen and heard should make mastery not difficult."
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 22, with his mother recovered, he was made Vice Director-general of Southern Rivers; the emperor said his years with Cengyun had trained him well.

sentences.zh: 母雖年近八十，常、淮帶水，侭可輕舟迎養，固無異在家侍奉也。

translations.literal: " Though your mother is nearly eighty, Chang and Huai are waterways where you may easily bring her by light boat to serve her—no different from home."
translations.idiomatic: "Though she is nearly eighty, the Chang and Huai routes allow light boats—caring for her need not differ from home."

sentences.zh: 」四月，上南巡，臨視高堰、清口及徐州諸工。

translations.literal: " In the fourth month the emperor toured south and personally inspected Gaobao, Qingkou, and the works at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " In month 4 the emperor toured south and inspected Gaobao, Qingkou, and Xuzhou works.

sentences.zh: 以伏汛將至，近河諸地歲頻歉，貧民甚多，諭疏築諸工同時並舉，以工代賑。

translations.literal: As the spring flood season was approaching, the lands near the river had suffered frequent poor harvests and there were many poor people; he was instructed that dredging and building works should all be undertaken at once, using labor for relief.
translations.idiomatic: With the spring flood near and many poor along the river, he was told to run dredging and building together as work-for-relief.

sentences.zh: 因璜前奏請於昭關增滾壩、濬支河，南關舊壩改建滾水石壩，即命璜董其事。

translations.literal: Because Huang had earlier memorialized to add rolling dams at Zhaoguan and dredge branch channels, and rebuild the old south dam as a rolling stone dam, he was ordered to take charge.
translations.idiomatic: As Huang had asked for rolling dams at Zhaoguan, branch dredging, and a new stone rolling dam at the south sluice, he was put in charge.

sentences.zh: 璜奏：「運河東堤減水入下河，經劉莊、伍祐、新興諸場，分注鬥龍、新洋二港歸海。

translations.literal: Huang memorialized: "The canal's east dike discharges overflow into the lower river, passing Liuzhuang, Wuyou, Xinxing, and other stations, dividing into the Doulong and Xinyang harbors to reach the sea."
translations.idiomatic: Huang wrote that canal overflow east of the dike passed Liuzhuang and other stations to Doulong and Xinyang harbors and the sea.

sentences.zh: 但劉莊大團閘至新興石閘相距較遠，請於伍祐沿窪口、蔡家港各增建石閘，引水出新洋港。

translations.literal: But from the great Liuzhuang sluice to Xinxing stone sluice the distance is rather far; he asked to build stone sluices at Wuyou along the depression mouth and at Caijiagang to lead water into Xinyang Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: He asked stone sluices at Wuyou and Caijiagang between Liuzhuang and Xinxing to send water to Xinyang Harbor.

sentences.zh: 並疏射陽湖港口，使之徑直。

translations.literal: And dredge the mouth of Sheyang Lake so it runs straight.
translations.idiomatic: Sheyang Lake's mouth should also be dredged straight.

sentences.zh: 濬串場河以西孔家溝、岡溝河、皮家河支流凡三。

translations.literal: West of the Chuanchang River dredge three tributaries: Kongjiagou, Gangou River, and Pijia River.
translations.idiomatic: West of the Chuanchang River he listed three tributaries—Kongjiagou, Gangou, and Pijia—to dredge.

sentences.zh: 此皆下河歸海之路也。

translations.literal: These are all routes by which the lower river reaches the sea.
translations.idiomatic: All were lower-river routes to the sea.

sentences.zh: 湖河諸水，歸海紆回，歸江迳直。

translations.literal: Lake and river waters reach the sea by winding paths but reach the Yangtze by direct routes.
translations.idiomatic: Lake and river water reached the sea by winding paths but the Yangtze by straighter ones.

sentences.zh: 多一分入江，即少一分入海。

translations.literal: Every part more into the Yangtze is a part less into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Every fraction sent to the Yangtze was a fraction less to the sea.

sentences.zh: 應挑河築壩，使湖河水勢相平，乃將各壩開放。

translations.literal: Dikes and canals should be cut so lake and river levels balance, then the various dams may be opened.
translations.idiomatic: Canals and dams should be cut until lake and river stood level, then the dams could open.

sentences.zh: 則湖水既減，可為容納來水地。

translations.literal: Then the lake water having decreased can serve as space to hold incoming water.
translations.idiomatic: Lower lake levels would leave room for incoming water.

sentences.zh: 伏秋水盛，洩高郵湖引入運河，出車邏、南關二壩，則歸海水少，下河田廬可無慮矣。

translations.literal: When autumn flood waters are high, discharge Gaoyou Lake into the canal through Cheba and Nanguan dams, then less returns to the sea and lower-river fields and houses need not fear."
translations.idiomatic: "In autumn floods, Gaoyou Lake could spill into the canal at Cheba and Nanguan, sparing the lower river fields."

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「璜此奏分別緩急，因勢利導，會全局而熟籌之。

translations.literal: " The emperor instructed: "Huang's memorial distinguishes urgency, follows the terrain, and plans the whole with care."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Huang for ranking priorities, following terrain, and planning the whole system.

sentences.zh: 改紆為直，移遠為近，濬淺為深，具有條理。

translations.literal: Change winding to straight, move far to near, dredge shallow to deep—it has order."
translations.idiomatic: "Turn winding to straight, distant to near, shallow to deep—well ordered."

sentences.zh: 即令尹繼善、白鍾山等會璜次第興舉。

translations.literal: Let Yin Jishan, Bai Zhongshan, and others join Huang in carrying it out in sequence."
translations.idiomatic: He told Yin Jishan, Bai Zhongshan, and others to implement it with Huang step by step.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，高郵運河東堤新建石壩工成，奏請酌定水則，車邏、南關二壩過水至三尺五寸，開五里中閘；

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month the new stone dam on the Gaoyou canal east dike was completed; he memorialized to fix water rules: when Cheba and Nanguan dams pass water to three chi five cun, open the middle sluice five li away;
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 the new Gaoyou east-bank stone dam was done; he set rules—at three chi five cun on Cheba and Nanguan, open the middle sluice five li away;

sentences.zh: 至五尺，開新建石壩。

translations.literal: at five chi, open the new stone dam.
translations.idiomatic: at five chi, open the new stone dam.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「車邏、南關壩脊高於高郵湖面二尺七寸。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The crest of Cheba and Nanguan dams is two chi seven cun higher than Gaoyou Lake."
translations.idiomatic: He noted Cheba and Nanguan crests stood two chi seven cun above Gaoyou Lake.

sentences.zh: 芒稻閘為湖水歸江第一尾閭，請常年啟放，俾江、湖脈絡貫通。

translations.literal: The Mangdao sluice is the first tail outlet for lake water returning to the Yangtze; he asked it be kept open year-round so Yangtze and lake pulses connect."
translations.idiomatic: Mangdao sluice, the lake's first outlet to the Yangtze, should stay open so river and lake stayed linked.

sentences.zh: 」上深嘉之，從所請，並降旨命勒石閘畔。

translations.literal: " The emperor greatly praised it, granted his requests, and ordered an inscription carved beside the sluice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved, praised him deeply, and ordered an inscription at the sluice.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月，擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-third year he was promoted Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 23 he became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 五月，上下江諸工皆竟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month all works on upper and lower Jiang were finished.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 upper and lower Jiang works were finished.

sentences.zh: 九月，調禮部。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was transferred to Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 he moved to Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十四年四月，請在籍終養。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fourth year he asked to complete mourning at home.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 of year 24 he asked to finish mourning at home.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，詣京師祝上壽。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he went to the capital to congratulate the emperor on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 he went to court for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 歸至清江浦，奏言：「歸江之路，尚有應籌。

translations.literal: Returning to Qingjiangpu he memorialized: "The route back to the Yangtze still needs planning."
translations.idiomatic: Back at Qingjiangpu he said the Yangtze return route still needed work.

sentences.zh: 請於金灣壩下開引河，並濬董家溝。

translations.literal: He asked to open a diversion below Jinwan Dam and dredge Dongjiagou.
translations.idiomatic: He asked a diversion below Jinwan Dam and dredging of Dongjiagou.

sentences.zh: 又以廖家溝、石羊溝、董家溝三壩改低三尺，使與芒稻閘相準。

translations.literal: He also asked the three dams at Liaojiagou, Shiyangou, and Dongjiagou lowered three chi to match Mangdao sluice."
translations.idiomatic: He also asked Liaojiagou, Shiyangou, and Dongjiagou lowered three chi to match Mangdao.

sentences.zh: 」上命交尹繼善等勘議。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered Yin Jishan and others to survey and discuss.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Yin Jishan and others to survey.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，丁母憂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year his mother died.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 his mother died.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，服闋，署禮部尚書，旋實授。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, mourning ended, he acted as Minister of Rites and soon received the substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In year 32, mourning done, he acted then held Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 七月，授河東河道總督，奏：「楊橋大壩為河南第一要工，雖已堵閉，時輒滲漏。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was appointed Director-general of Eastern Rivers and memorialized: "The Yangqiao great dam is Henan's foremost work; though blocked, it often seeps."
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 he became Eastern Rivers director-general and reported Yangqiao dam, though closed, often leaked.

sentences.zh: 而北岸河灘順直，既不能挑引河分溜，大壩迤東又遍地飛沙，不能建越堤。

translations.literal: The north-bank beach is straight and a diversion cannot be cut to split the current; east of the dam flying sand is everywhere and overflow dikes cannot be built.
translations.idiomatic: The north bank was too straight for diversions; east of the dam flying sand forbade overflow dikes.

sentences.zh: 請將壩身裹戧培厚，用資完固。

translations.literal: He asked to wrap and thicken the dam body for solidity."
translations.idiomatic: He asked the dam body wrapped and thickened.

sentences.zh: 」璜每巡河，不避艱險，身先屬吏。

translations.literal: " On every river tour Huang did not shun hardship and led his subordinates in person.
translations.idiomatic: On river tours Huang never shunned hardship and led from the front.

sentences.zh: 一夕聞虞城工險，馳往。

translations.literal: One night hearing danger at Yucheng works he galloped there.
translations.idiomatic: One night hearing Yucheng was in peril he rode there at once.

sentences.zh: 天甫曉，雨雹交下，下埽岌岌欲崩，從者失色，勸璜姑退。

translations.literal: At first light rain and hail fell together; the brush revetment was on the verge of collapse; his followers turned pale and urged Huang to withdraw for the moment.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn rain and hail struck; the revetment nearly failed; aides begged him to step back.

sentences.zh: 璜立堤上叱曰：「埽去我與俱去！

translations.literal: Huang stood on the dike and shouted: "If the revetment goes I go with it!"
translations.idiomatic: Huang stood on the dike and cried: "If the revetment goes, I go with it!"

sentences.zh: 」雨雹息，堤卒無恙。

translations.literal: " The rain and hail stopped and the dike was unharmed in the end.
translations.idiomatic: The storm passed and the dike held.

sentences.zh: 三十三年九月，召授工部尚書，罷直南書房。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirty-third year he was summoned and made Minister of Works, leaving the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 of year 33 he was summoned as Minister of Works and left the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 尋以在河督任未甄別佐雜，左遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: Soon, because while river director he had not classified assistants and clerks, he was demoted to Left Vice Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was demoted to Left Vice Censor-in-chief for failing to classify river staff while director.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 he became Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，擢尚書，調兵部。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was promoted minister and transferred to War.
translations.idiomatic: In year 38 he was promoted minister and moved to War.

sentences.zh: 四十年，復調工部。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was transferred back to Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 40 he returned to Works.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，調吏部，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he was transferred to Personnel and assisted as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In year 44 he moved to Personnel and assisted as Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 初，璜議挽黃河北流仍歸山東故道，入對嘗及之。

translations.literal: Earlier Huang had proposed turning the Yellow River north back to Shandong's old course and had mentioned it in audience.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Huang had urged returning the Yellow River north to Shandong's old bed and said so at court.

sentences.zh: 是歲河決青龍岡，大學士阿桂視工。

translations.literal: That year the river broke at Qinglonggang; Grand Secretary Agui inspected the works.
translations.idiomatic: That year the river broke at Qinglonggang; Grand Secretary Agui inspected.

sentences.zh: 上以璜議諮阿桂及河督李奉翰，僉謂地北高南低，水性就下；

translations.literal: The emperor consulted Huang's plan with Agui and Director-general Li Fenghan; all said the land is higher north and lower south and water seeks the lower level;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Agui and Director-general Li Fenghan; all said the north was higher, the south lower—water runs downhill;

sentences.zh: 欲導河北注，揣時度勢，斷不能行。

translations.literal: to lead the river north and down, judging time and terrain, certainly cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: forcing the Yellow River north, they said, could not be done.

sentences.zh: 上復命廷臣集議，仍謂黃河南徙已久，不可輕議改道，寢其事。

translations.literal: The emperor again ordered court discussion; they still said the Yellow River had moved south too long to change course lightly, and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Court debate again held the river had been south too long to shift lightly, and the plan died.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，加太子太保，在上書房總師傅上行走。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and walked as chief tutor in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In year 47 he became Grand Guardian and chief tutor in the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 並以璜年老，諭冬令日出後入朝，賜玄狐端罩。

translations.literal: Because Huang was old, he was told to enter court after sunrise in winter and was given a sable-lined formal coat.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he might enter after sunrise; he received a sable-lined court robe.

sentences.zh: 五十年正月，與千叟宴，為漢大臣領班。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fiftieth year he joined the banquet for a thousand elders and led the Han ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 50 he led Han ministers at the thousand-elder banquet.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，以老乞休，賜詩慰留。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, old, he begged to retire; the emperor sent a poem urging him to stay.
translations.idiomatic: In year 51 he begged to retire; the emperor answered with a poem asking him to remain.

sentences.zh: 上幸避暑山莊，命留京辦事。

translations.literal: When the emperor went to the Summer Resort he was ordered to remain in the capital on business.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went to the Summer Resort he stayed in Beijing on duty.

sentences.zh: 五十五年四月，以璜成進士逾六十年，重與恩榮宴。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifty-fifth year, because Huang had been a jinshi for more than sixty years, he again received the grace banquet.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 of year 55, sixty years from his jinshi, he received the grace banquet again.

sentences.zh: 璜年八十，與高宗同歲生，生日在六月，奏改萬壽節後。

translations.literal: Huang was eighty and born in the same year as Emperor Gaozong; his birthday was in the sixth month; he memorialized to move it after the Longevity Festival.
translations.idiomatic: Huang was eighty, born the same year as Qianlong; his birthday fell in the sixth month and he asked to celebrate after the Longevity Festival.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其知禮，代定八月十九日，賜詩及聯榜、上方珍玩寵之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his propriety, fixed the eighth month nineteenth day for him, and bestowed poems, couplets, and imperial treasures.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his tact, set the date as the nineteenth of the eighth month, and gave poems and imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，复賜肩輿入直。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he was again granted a sedan chair for attendance at court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 56 he again received a sedan chair for court.

sentences.zh: 五十九年七月，卒，年八十有四，命皇八子奠醊，贈太子太師，賜祭葬，諡文恭。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifty-ninth year he died, aged eighty-four; the eighth imperial son was ordered to offer libations; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, with funeral rites and posthumous name Wengong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 of year 59 he died at eighty-four; the eighth prince offered libations; he was posthumously Grand Tutor with posthumous name Wengong.

sentences.zh: 子八，長承謙，進士，官至侍讀，先璜卒。

translations.literal: He had eight sons; the eldest Chengqian, a jinshi, rose to reader and died before Huang.
translations.idiomatic: He had eight sons; eldest Chengqian, a jinshi and reader, died before him.

sentences.zh: 族子承恩，舉人，累官至河東河道總督。

translations.literal: A clansman Chengen, a provincial graduate, rose in succession to Director-general of Eastern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Clansman Chengen, a provincial graduate, became Eastern Rivers director-general.

sentences.zh: 高斌，字右文，高佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，初隸內務府。

translations.literal: Gao Bin, courtesy name Youwen, of the Gaojia clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, was at first under the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin, courtesy name Youwen, of the Gaojia clan, was a Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu first under the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授內務府主事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was appointed director of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he became an Imperial Household director.

sentences.zh: 再遷郎中，管蘇州織造。

translations.literal: He was promoted twice to bureau director and managed Suzhou weaving.
translations.idiomatic: He rose twice to bureau director and ran Suzhou weaving.

sentences.zh: 六年，授廣東布政使，調浙江、江蘇、河南諸省。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Guangdong provincial treasurer, then transferred through Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he was Guangdong treasurer, then served Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷河東副總河。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was made Vice Director-general of Eastern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he became Vice Director-general of Eastern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 十年，調兩淮鹽政，兼署江寧織造。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Liang-Huai salt administration and also acted as Nanjing weaving superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he took Liang-Huai salt and acted as Nanjing weaving superintendent.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he acted as Director-general of Jiangnan Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he acted as Jiangnan river director-general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，回鹽政任。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he returned to the salt post.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he returned to salt.

sentences.zh: 复署河道總督，培范公堤六萬四千餘丈。

translations.literal: He again acted as river director-general and strengthened the Fan Gong dike more than 64,000 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: He again directed rivers and strengthened the Fan Gong dike over 64,000 zhang.

sentences.zh: 十三年，回鹽政任。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he returned to the salt post.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he returned to salt again.

sentences.zh: 旋授江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Director-general of Jiangnan Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Jiangnan river director-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，疏請河工搶修工段需用土方，令河兵挑運十之四​​，用民工十之六。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he memorialized that emergency river repair sections need earthwork and ordered river soldiers to carry four-tenths and hired labor six-tenths.
