translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he set emergency earthwork at four-tenths river soldiers and six-tenths hired labor.

sentences.zh: 又請葦蕩營採柴均歸廠運。

translations.literal: He also asked that reed-marsh camp fuel cutting all go through official transport from the depots.
translations.idiomatic: Reed-marsh fuel cutting was to go through depot transport.

sentences.zh: 又請各州縣河工外解各項悉歸河庫道。

translations.literal: He also asked that all river works extra payments from prefectures and counties go through the river treasury intendant.
translations.idiomatic: All prefectural river surcharges were to pass through the river treasury intendant.

sentences.zh: 河南永城、江南蕭縣頻年被河患，上命高斌會兩江總督趙弘恩、河南巡撫富德籌疏通之策。

translations.literal: Yongcheng in Henan and Xiaoxian in Jiangnan had suffered frequent river disasters; the emperor ordered Gao Bin with Governors-general Zhao Hongen and Henan governor Fude to plan drainage.
translations.idiomatic: Frequent floods hit Yongcheng and Xiaoxian; Gao Bin joined Zhao Hongen and Fude to plan relief.

sentences.zh: 高斌等奏：「黃河南岸碭山毛城鋪向有減水石壩一，蕭縣王家山有天然減水石閘一，睢寧縣峰山有減水閘四，建自康熙間，誠分黃導淮以水治水之善策。

translations.literal: Gao Bin and others memorialized: "On the Yellow River's south bank at Dangshan Maochengpu there was one stone overflow dam; at Wangjiashan in Xiaoxian a natural stone overflow sluice; at Fengshan in Suining four overflow sluices—all built in Kangxi's time, truly the excellent policy of dividing Yellow to guide Huai and using water to control water."
translations.idiomatic: They cited Kangxi-era overflow works at Maochengpu, Wangjiashan, and Fengshan as the classic policy of splitting Yellow water to guide the Huai.

sentences.zh: 年久淤淺，水發為患。

translations.literal: After many years they silted shallow and floods became disasters.
translations.idiomatic: After years they had silted and floods worsened.

sentences.zh: 毛城鋪舊有洪溝、巴河二河，為減洩黃水故道。

translations.literal: Maochengpu once had Honggou and Bahe as old channels to discharge Yellow water.
translations.idiomatic: Maochengpu's Honggou and Bahe had been Yellow River spillways.

sentences.zh: 閘下地勢，東北偏高，水向南行，漫入祝家口。

translations.literal: Below the sluice the terrain slopes higher northeast; water runs south and floods Zhujiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Below the sluice the bed sloped northeast; water ran south into Zhujiakou.

sentences.zh: 請俟水涸疏濬二河，並於二河上游開蔣溝河，築祝家口、潘家口二壩。

translations.literal: He asked when the water falls to dredge the two rivers and open Jianggou upstream, building dams at Zhujiakou and Panjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: When water fell he asked both rivers dredged, Jianggou opened upstream, and dams at Zhujiakou and Panjiakou.

sentences.zh: 漳水南流，使盡入蔣溝、洪溝、巴河分流下注，永城、碭山諸縣當無水患。

translations.literal: Zhang River flowing south should all enter Jianggou, Honggou, and Bahe to divide and discharge, and Yongcheng, Dangshan, and other counties should be free of flood.
translations.idiomatic: South-flowing Zhang water should split through Jianggou, Honggou, and Bahe so Yongcheng and Dangshan would be safe.

sentences.zh: 王家山天然閘減水會入徐溪口，舊有引河，間有淤淺；

translations.literal: Wangjiashan's natural sluice discharges into Xuxikou; there was an old diversion, sometimes silted;
translations.idiomatic: Wangjiashan's natural sluice fed Xuxikou; its diversion sometimes silted;

sentences.zh: 峰山減水四閘，歷年既久，引河亦有淤淺：均應疏濬。

translations.literal: Fengshan's four overflow sluices, after many years, also had silted diversions: all should be dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Fengshan's four sluices and diversions also needed dredging.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「淮揚運河自清口至瓜洲三百餘裡，其源為分洪澤湖水入天妃閘，建瓴而下，經淮安、寶應、高郵、揚州以達於江，惟借東西漕堤為障。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The Huai-Yang canal from Qingkou to Guazhou is more than three hundred li; its source is Hongze Lake water divided at Tianfei sluice, pouring down through Huai'an, Baoying, Gaoyou, and Yangzhou to the Yangtze, relying only on east and west grain dikes as barriers."
translations.idiomatic: He described the 300-li Huai-Yang canal from Qingkou to Guazhou, fed by Hongze through Tianfei sluice, bounded only by grain dikes.

sentences.zh: 請於天妃、正越兩閘之下，相距百餘丈，各建草壩三。

translations.literal: He asked below Tianfei and Zhengyue sluices, a hundred-odd zhang apart, to build three grass dams each.
translations.idiomatic: Below Tianfei and Zhengyue he asked three grass dams each, a hundred-odd zhang apart.

sentences.zh: 壩下建正石閘二，越河石閘二。

translations.literal: Below the dams build two main stone sluices and two bypass stone sluices.
translations.idiomatic: Below them he wanted two main and two bypass stone sluices.

sentences.zh: 又於所建二閘尾各建草壩三。

translations.literal: At the tail of each of the two sluices build three more grass dams.
translations.idiomatic: At each new sluice tail he asked three more grass dams.

sentences.zh: 重重關鎖，層層收蓄，則水平溜緩，可禦洪澤湖異漲，亦可減運河水勢。

translations.literal: Layer upon layer of locks and storage, then the water level and current ease, can resist Hongze's abnormal rises and also reduce canal force.
translations.idiomatic: Layered locks would ease the current, hold Hongze floods, and calm the canal.

sentences.zh: 湖水三分入運，七分會黃。

translations.literal: Three parts lake water into the canal, seven parts join the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Three-tenths of lake water would enter the canal, seven-tenths meet the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 山盱尾閭天然南北二壩，非洪澤湖異漲不可輕開，使清水全力禦黃；

translations.literal: Shanxi's natural north and south tail dams should not be opened lightly except in Hongze floods, so clear water fully resists the Yellow;
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi's natural north and south tail dams should open only in Hongze floods so clear water held the Yellow;

sentences.zh: 而高、寶諸湖所受之水，循軌入口，不至泛溢下河。

translations.literal: while Gaobao and other lakes' incoming water follows the channel in without flooding the lower river.
translations.idiomatic: Gaobao and other lakes would feed in without flooding the lower river.

sentences.zh: 則高、寶、興、鹽諸縣民田可免洪湖洩水之患。

translations.literal: Then the fields of Gaobao, Xing, and Salt districts can be spared Hongze discharge disasters."
translations.idiomatic: Gaobao, Xing, and salt districts would escape Hongze spill damage.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，均議行。

translations.literal: " The memorial entered and all was approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 御史夏之芳等疏言：「毛城鋪引河一開，則高堰危，淮、揚運道民生可慮。

translations.literal: Censor Xia Zhifang and others memorialized: "If Maochengpu diversion is opened, Gaobao will be endangered and Huai-Yang canal and people's livelihood are to be feared."
translations.idiomatic: Censor Xia Zhifang warned Maochengpu diversion would endanger Gaobao and Huai-Yang.

sentences.zh: 」命高斌會大學士嵇曾筠、副總河劉永澄等詳度。

translations.literal: " He was ordered to join Grand Secretary Ji Cengyun, Vice Director-general Liu Yongcheng, and others in detailed survey.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin was told to survey with Ji Cengyun and Liu Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 安徽布政使晏斯盛、廣東學政王安國復請濬海口，又命高斌與宏恩及江蘇巡撫邵基會勘。

translations.literal: Anhui treasurer Yan Sisheng and Guangdong education intendant Wang Anguo again asked to dredge the estuary; Gao Bin was again ordered with Hongen and Jiangsu governor Shao Ji to survey jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Sisheng and Wang Anguo asked estuary dredging; Gao Bin joined Hongen and Shao Ji to survey.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，高斌請入覲。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year Gao Bin asked to enter audience.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 of year 2 Gao Bin asked audience.

sentences.zh: 趙弘恩內擢戶部尚書，亦詣京師。

translations.literal: Zhao Hongen was promoted within to Minister of Revenue and also went to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hongen, promoted to Minister of Revenue, also went to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 上命王大臣集議，並召之芳等皆與。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered princes and ministers to assemble for discussion and summoned Xia Zhifang and others to attend.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor convened princes and ministers and summoned Xia Zhifang and others.

sentences.zh: 高斌言：「毛城鋪減水壩康熙十七年靳輔所建，減水歸洪澤湖，助清刷黃。

translations.literal: Gao Bin said: "The Maochengpu overflow dam was built by Jin Fu in the seventeenth year of Kangxi; its overflow returns to Hongze Lake and helps clear water scour the Yellow."
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin said Jin Fu built Maochengpu overflow dam in Kangxi 17 to send water to Hongze and help clear water scour Yellow silt.

sentences.zh: 六十年來，河道民生，均受其益。

translations.literal: For sixty years the river course and people's livelihood have all benefited.
translations.idiomatic: For sixty years the channel and people had benefited.

sentences.zh: 現濬毛城鋪，乃因壩下舊河量加挑濬，使水有所歸，並非開壩。

translations.literal: The present dredging at Maochengpu is only adding dredging to the old river below the dam so water has somewhere to go; it is not opening the dam.
translations.idiomatic: Present work only deepened the old channel below the dam—not opening the dam itself.

sentences.zh: 況減下之水，紆回曲折六百餘裡，經徐、蕭、睢、宿、靈、虹諸州縣，有楊甿等五湖為之渟蓄。

translations.literal: Moreover the discharged water winds more than six hundred li through Xuzhou, Xiaoxian, Suining, Sizhou, Lingbi, Hong, and other prefectures and counties, with Yangmeng and five other lakes to store it.
translations.idiomatic: Discharged water wound 600 li through Xuzhou, Xiaoxian, and other counties, stored in Yangmeng and five lakes.

sentences.zh: 入湖時即已澄清，無挾沙入湖之患，亦無湖不能容之慮。

translations.literal: When it enters the lake it is already clear; there is no fear of carrying sand into the lake, nor that the lake cannot hold it."
translations.idiomatic: By the lake it was clear—no sand scourge, no fear the lake could not hold it.

sentences.zh: 」之芳等仍執所見，議未決，御史甄之璜奏：「毛城鋪開河，淮、揚百萬之眾，憂慮惶恐。

translations.literal: " Xia Zhifang and others still held their view; discussion was unresolved; Censor Zhen Zhihuang memorialized: "Opening Maochengpu, the million people of Huai-Yang are anxious and fearful."
translations.idiomatic: Xia Zhifang held firm; Censor Zhen Zhihuang said Huai-Yang's millions were terrified of opening Maochengpu.

sentences.zh: 」鍾衡條奏亦及之。

translations.literal: " Zhong Heng's detailed memorial also touched on it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Heng's memorial said the same.

sentences.zh: 上卒用高斌議，斥之璜、衡、之芳等。

translations.literal: The emperor finally adopted Gao Bin's plan and rebuked Zhihuang, Heng, Xia Zhifang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took Gao Bin's side and rebuked Zhihuang, Heng, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 高斌復請別開新運口，堵塞舊運口，以避黃河倒灌。

translations.literal: Gao Bin again asked to open a new transport mouth separately and block the old transport mouth to avoid Yellow River backflow.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin asked a new grain mouth opened and the old one blocked against Yellow backflow.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，淮、揚運河工竟，有旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, Huai-Yang canal works were finished; an edict praised them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, month 1, Huai-Yang canal work was done and praised.

sentences.zh: 四年，上聞時論議高斌所改新運口離黃稍遠，而上游水勢遇黃河異漲，仍不見倒灌，命大學士鄂爾泰乘驛往勘。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the emperor heard opinion that Gao Bin's new transport mouth was somewhat far from the Yellow, yet when upstream met abnormal Yellow rise it still did not backflow; he ordered Grand Secretary Ortai to go post-haste to survey.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 opinion held Gao Bin's new mouth was safer; Qianlong sent Grand Secretary Ortai to verify.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰仍主開新運口，如高斌議。

translations.literal: Ortai still favored opening the new transport mouth as Gao Bin proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai still backed the new transport mouth.

sentences.zh: 八月，高斌入覲，命便道與直隸總督孫嘉淦、總河顧琮會勘直隸河道。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Gao Bin entered audience; he was ordered by the way to join Zhili governor Sun Jiagan and Director-general Gu Cong in surveying Zhili river works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 Gao Bin had audience and was told to survey Zhili rivers with Sun Jiagan and Gu Cong.

sentences.zh: 六年，奏言：「黃河自宿遷下至清河，河流湍急，內逼運河，脣齒相依。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he memorialized: "From Suyuan below to Qinghe the Yellow River current is swift and presses the canal lip to lip."
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he said from Suyuan to Qinghe the Yellow ran fast and pressed the canal.

sentences.zh: 請培運河南岸縷堤，作為黃河北岸遙堤。

translations.literal: He asked to strengthen the canal south bank thread dike as the Yellow River north bank setback dike.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the canal's south thread dike serve as the Yellow's north setback dike.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「江都瓜河地勢卑下，請量改口門，別濬越河，以減淮水入瓜河分數。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Guazhou in Jiangdu is low; measure and change the mouth and dredge a bypass canal to reduce the share of Huai water entering Guazhou."
translations.idiomatic: He also asked Guazhou's low mouth moved and a bypass cut to cut Huai inflow.

sentences.zh: 」又言鎮江南岸埽工宜改磚工。

translations.literal: " He also said Zhenjiang south-bank brush works should be changed to brick.
translations.idiomatic: He asked Zhenjiang south-bank brush changed to brick.

sentences.zh: 均下部議行。

translations.literal: All were sent to the ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All went to the ministries for implementation.

sentences.zh: 調直隸總督，兼管總河。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Zhili governor-general and also managed the director-general of rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He became Zhili governor-general and river director-general.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「永定河惟在尾閭通暢，請於三角淀旁開引河，下接大清河老河頭，上接鄭家樓水口。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Yongding River depends only on a clear tail outlet; he asked to open a diversion beside Sanjiao Pond connecting to the old Daqing River head below and Zhengjialou mouth above.
translations.idiomatic: He asked a Yongding diversion at Sanjiao Pond linking Zhengjialou to the Daqing River.

sentences.zh: 挑去積土，即於北岸圈築坡埝，以防北軼。

translations.literal: Remove accumulated earth and on the north bank build slope embankments to prevent north overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Excavated spoil would become north-bank slope embankments against north overflow.

sentences.zh: 南岸亦量為接築，以遏南溜。

translations.literal: On the south bank also build links as needed to check south current.
translations.idiomatic: The south bank would be linked to check south current.

sentences.zh: 下口河脣，隨時疏通。

translations.literal: The lower mouth sand bar should be dredged as needed.
translations.idiomatic: The lower mouth sand bar would be dredged as needed.

sentences.zh: 至上游應籌分洩，請於南岸雙營，北岸胡林店、小惠家莊各增建三合土滾壩一；

translations.literal: Upstream should plan divided discharge; he asked at Shuangying on the south bank and Hulindian and Xiaohuijiazhuang on the north bank each to add one rammed-earth rolling dam;
translations.idiomatic: Upstream he asked rolling dams at Shuangying south and Hulindian and Xiaohuijiazhuang north;

sentences.zh: 並減堤高，使卑於壩。

translations.literal: and lower the dike height so it is lower than the dam.
translations.idiomatic: and dikes lowered below dam crest.

sentences.zh: 南岸郭家堤舊草壩應一律修築如式。

translations.literal: Guojia dike's old grass dam on the south bank should be repaired uniformly to the same pattern."
translations.idiomatic: Guojia's old south-bank grass dam should be rebuilt to match.

sentences.zh: 」七年，淮、揚水災，上命高斌及侍郎週學健會總督德沛等治賑。

translations.literal: " In the seventh year Huai-Yang suffered flood; the emperor ordered Gao Bin and Vice Minister Zhou Xuejian to join Governor-general Depu and others in relief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Huai-Yang flooded; Gao Bin and Zhou Xuejian joined Depu on relief.

sentences.zh: 事畢，還直隸，復奏言：「永定河上游為桑乾河，自山西大同至直隸西寧，兩岸可各開渠灌田。

translations.literal: When done he returned to Zhili and memorialized again: "The Yongding's upper reach is the Sanggan; from Datong in Shanxi to Xining in Zhili, both banks can open canals for irrigation."
translations.idiomatic: Back in Zhili he said the Sanggan from Datong to Xining could irrigate both banks.

sentences.zh: 自西寧石閘村入山，經宣化黑龍灣、懷來和合堡、宛平沿河口，兩山夾峙，一線中趨。

translations.literal: From Xining Shizha Village it enters the mountains, passes Xuanhua Heilongwan, Huailai Hehebao, Wanping along the river mouth, mountains pressing on both sides, a single thread in the center.
translations.idiomatic: From Xining it ran through mountains—Xuanhua, Huailai, Wanping—in a single gorge.

sentences.zh: 若於山口取巨石錯落堆疊，仿竹絡壩之意，為玲瓏水壩，以殺其洶湧，則下游河患可減。

translations.literal: If at the mountain mouth huge stones are piled irregularly in the manner of bamboo-cage dams as an openwork water dam to kill the surge, downstream river peril can be reduced."
translations.idiomatic: Openwork stone dams at the gorge mouth, he said, would tame the surge and ease downstream peril.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，均議行。

translations.literal: " The memorial entered and all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 of year 10 he became Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五月，授吏部尚書，仍管直隸水利、河道工程。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was appointed Minister of Personnel, still managing Zhili water conservancy and river works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 he became Minister of Personnel, still over Zhili water works.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命協辦大學士、軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary and walk in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 he assisted as Grand Secretary on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 十一年，御史楊開鼎劾南河河道總督白鍾山河決匿災不報，命高斌往江南會總督尹繼善按治，白鍾山坐奪官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Censor Yang Kaiding impeached Southern Rivers Director-general Bai Zhongshan for concealing a breach; Gao Bin was ordered to Jiangnan with Governor-general Yin Jishan to investigate; Bai Zhongshan was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Censor Yang Kaiding accused Bai Zhongshan of hiding a breach; Gao Bin investigated with Yin Jishan; Bai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「淮、黃二瀆，每年伏秋水漲，以老壩口水志為準則。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Huai and Yellow channels each year in spring and autumn floods use the old dam mouth water gauge as standard."
translations.idiomatic: He said Huai and Yellow floods used the old dam gauge as standard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年最大，水志連底水一丈四尺七寸，當以此較量每年水勢。

translations.literal: Qianlong 7 was greatest, gauge including bottom water one zhang four chi seven cun; each year's water force should be compared to this.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 7's peak—one zhang four chi seven cun on the gauge—should be the yearly benchmark.

sentences.zh: 各處閘壩開閉，應以就近石工水漲尺寸為度。

translations.literal: Opening and closing sluices and dams everywhere should take nearby stonework flood marks as measure."
translations.idiomatic: Sluices should open and close by nearby stone flood marks.

sentences.zh: 」運河水漲，又命高斌往勘。

translations.literal: " The canal water rose and Gao Bin was again ordered to survey.
translations.idiomatic: When the canal rose he was sent to survey again.

sentences.zh: 疏陳培六塘河謝家莊、龍溝口諸處堤堰，濬中墩河、項家衝東門河；

translations.literal: He memorialized strengthening dikes at Xiejiazhuang and Longgoukou on the Liutang River and dredging Zhongdun River and Xiangjiachong East Gate River;
translations.idiomatic: He strengthened Liutang dikes and dredged Zhongdun and Xiangjiachong rivers;

sentences.zh: 又疏請豁免海州、沭陽​​、贛榆諸縣逋賦，及板浦、徐瀆、中正、莞瀆、臨洪、興莊諸場折價帶徵銀：並從之。

translations.literal: he also asked exemption of back taxes in Haizhou, Shuyang, Ganyu and conversion of levies at various salt fields: all approved.
translations.idiomatic: he exempted Haizhou and Shuyang taxes and eased salt-field levies—all approved.

sentences.zh: 高斌嘗謂黃水宜合不宜分，清水宜蓄不宜洩，惟規度湖河水勢，視其縮盈以定蓄洩，方不至泛溢阻礙為民害。

translations.literal: Gao Bin once said Yellow water should join not divide, clear water should store not discharge; only gauge lake and river force and fix storage and release by expansion and contraction, then overflow and obstruction will not harm the people.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin held Yellow water should stay united, clear water stored; only measured storage and release prevented harm.

sentences.zh: 諸所籌畫，皆可循守。

translations.literal: All his planning can be followed.
translations.idiomatic: His plans were sound precedent.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，授文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Deepness.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 of year 12 he became Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Deepness.

sentences.zh: 四月，命往江南同河道總督週學健督理防汛。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was ordered to Jiangnan with Director-general Zhou Xuejian to supervise flood defense.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 he went to Jiangnan with Zhou Xuejian on flood defense.

sentences.zh: 五月，直隸水利工竟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Zhili water works were finished.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Zhili water works finished.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命偕左都御史劉統勳如山東治賑。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered with Left Censor-in-chief Liu Tongxun to Shandong for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he and Liu Tongxun went to Shandong on relief.

sentences.zh: 又命偕總督顧琮如浙江按巡撫常安婪賄狀，高斌等頗不欲窮治。

translations.literal: He was also ordered with Governor-general Gu Cong to Zhejiang to investigate Governor Chang An's graft; Gao Bin and others were rather unwilling to pursue to the end.
translations.idiomatic: He and Gu Cong were sent to investigate Zhejiang governor Chang An's graft but were reluctant to press hard.

sentences.zh: 上又遣大學士訥親往按，責高斌模棱，下吏議，奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: The emperor again sent Grand Secretary Neqin; he rebuked Gao Bin for equivocation, referred him to the ministry for punishment, stripped his office, but ordered him to remain in post.
translations.idiomatic: Neqin was sent; Gao Bin was rebuked for equivocation, stripped yet kept in post.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，週學健得罪，命兼管江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month Zhou Xuejian was punished; he was ordered also to manage Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 7 Zhou Xuejian fell; Gao Bin also took Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 尋以籍學健家產徇私瞻顧，奪大學士，仍留河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon for favoring Zhou Xuejian in confiscating his family property he was stripped of Grand Secretary but kept as river director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he lost Grand Secretary rank for favoring Zhou in confiscation but kept the river post.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月，上南巡，命仍以大學士銜管河道總督事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixteenth year the emperor toured south and ordered him again to manage river affairs with Grand Secretary rank.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 of year 16, on the southern tour, he resumed Grand Secretary rank over rivers.

sentences.zh: 閏五月，暫管兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month he temporarily managed Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 5 he briefly ran Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 八月，盱南陽武漫工未合龍，詔往相度修築，命未下，高斌奏請馳赴協辦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Yangwu breach at Xuyang was not yet closed; an edict ordered survey and repair; before the order arrived Gao Bin memorialized asking to hurry to assist.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 the Xuyang Yangwu breach was open; Gao Bin asked to hurry there before the edict arrived.

sentences.zh: 上獎其急公任事，得大臣體。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his public zeal and said he had the bearing of a great minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his zeal as befitting a great minister.

sentences.zh: 十一月，工竟，命同侍郎汪由敦勘天津諸處河工。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the work was done; he was ordered with Vice Minister Wang Youdun to survey Tianjin river works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 the breach closed; he surveyed Tianjin works with Wang Youdun.

sentences.zh: 十七年，年七十，賜詩。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, aged seventy, he was granted a poem.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17, aged seventy, he received an imperial poem.

sentences.zh: 十八年，洪澤湖溢，邵伯運河二閘衝決，高郵、寶應諸縣被水，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Hongze overflowed; Shao Bo canal's two sluices were breached; Gaoyou, Baoying, and other counties were flooded; the ministry deliberated strictly.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Hongze spilled; Shao Bo sluices failed; Gaoyou and Baoying flooded; the ministry censured him.

sentences.zh: 學習河務布政使富勒赫奏劾南河虧帑，命署尚書策楞​​、尚書劉統勳往按。

translations.literal: Bureau intendant Fulehe, studying river affairs, memorialized Southern Rivers treasury deficits; Acting Minister Celeng and Minister Liu Tongxun were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Fulehe reported Southern Rivers treasury deficits; Celeng and Liu Tongxun investigated.

sentences.zh: 策楞等疏發外河同知陳克濟、海防同知王德宣虧帑狀；

translations.literal: Celeng and others memorialized exposing Outer River Vice Intendant Chen Keji and Coastal Defense Vice Intendant Wang Dexuan's deficits;
translations.idiomatic: Celeng exposed deficits by Chen Keji and Wang Dexuan;

sentences.zh: 並及洪澤湖水溢，通判週冕未為備，水至不能禦，不即奏劾狀。

translations.literal: and that when Hongze overflowed, Vice Intendant Zhou Mian had not prepared, could not resist when water came, and did not immediately memorialize impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: and that Zhou Mian had not prepared for Hongze's spill nor reported in time.

sentences.zh: 上責高斌徇縱，與協辦河務張師載並奪官，留工效力贖罪。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Gao Bin for indulgence, stripped him and Assistant Zhang Shizai together, but ordered them to remain on the works to redeem guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong rebuked Gao Bin's indulgence, stripped him and Zhang Shizai, yet kept them on the works.

sentences.zh: 九月，黃河決銅山張家路，南注靈、虹諸縣，歸洪澤湖，奪淮而下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Yellow River broke at Zhangjialu in Tongshan, flowing south through Lingbi, Hong, and other counties into Hongze Lake, seizing the Huai downward.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 the Yellow broke at Tongshan Zhangjialu, flooded south into Hongze, and overpowered the Huai.

sentences.zh: 上以秋汛已過，何至衝漫河堤，責高斌命往銅山勒限堵塞。

translations.literal: The emperor said the autumn flood had passed—how could the dike be breached—and rebuked Gao Bin, ordering him to Tongshan to block it within a time limit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked how a post-autumn breach could happen and sent Gao Bin to Tongshan to close it on deadline.

sentences.zh: 策楞尋奏同知李敦、守備張賓侵帑誤工狀，上命斬燉、賓，縶高斌、張師載使視行刑，仍傳旨釋之。

translations.literal: Celeng soon memorialized Vice Intendant Li Dun and Garrison Commander Zhang Bin for embezzling funds and botching works; the emperor ordered Dun and Bin beheaded, bound Gao Bin and Zhang Shizai to witness, then sent an edict releasing them.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng reported Li Dun and Zhang Bin for embezzlement; they were beheaded; Gao Bin and Zhang were bound to watch, then freed.

sentences.zh: 二十年三月，卒於工次。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twentieth year he died on the works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 of year 20 he died on the works.

sentences.zh: 予內大臣銜，發內庫銀一千治喪。

translations.literal: He was given the rank of inner court minister; a thousand taels from the inner treasury for funeral expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He received inner-court minister rank and 1,000 taels for his funeral.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上南巡，諭曰：「原任大學士、內大臣高斌，任河道總督時頗著勞績。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, on the southern tour, the emperor said: "Former Grand Secretary and Inner Minister Gao Bin, while river director-general, had notable achievements."
translations.idiomatic: On the year 22 southern tour the emperor recalled Gao Bin's river achievements.

sentences.zh: 即如毛城鋪所以分洩黃流，高斌設立徐州水志，至七尺方開。

translations.literal: Just as Maochengpu divides Yellow overflow, Gao Bin established the Xuzhou water gauge—only open at seven chi.
translations.idiomatic: Maochengpu divided Yellow water; his Xuzhou gauge opened only at seven chi.

sentences.zh: 後人不用其法，遂致黃弱沙淤，隱貽河患。

translations.literal: Later men did not use his method, and Yellow weakness and sand silt silently bred river peril.
translations.idiomatic: Later men ignored this; the Yellow weakened, silted, and bred disaster.

sentences.zh: 其於黃河兩岸汕刷支河，每歲冬季必率廳汛填築。

translations.literal: On both banks' branch channels scoured by overflow he every winter led bureau and flood-season officers to fill and build.
translations.idiomatic: Each winter he filled Yellow River branch scour channels on both banks.

sentences.zh: 近年工員疏忽，因有孫家集奪溜之事。

translations.literal: In recent years works officers were negligent, hence the Sunjiaji current-seizure affair.
translations.idiomatic: Recent negligence caused the Sunjiaji current seizure.

sentences.zh: 至三滾壩洩洪湖盛漲，高斌堅持堵閉，下游州縣屢獲豐收。

translations.literal: As for the three rolling dams discharging Hongze floods, Gao Bin insisted on blocking them; downstream prefectures and counties repeatedly had rich harvests.
translations.idiomatic: His insistence on blocking the three rolling dams let downstream counties harvest richly.

sentences.zh: 功在民生，自不可沒。

translations.literal: His merit for the people's livelihood cannot be erased.
translations.idiomatic: His service to the people could not be erased.

sentences.zh: 癸酉張家路及運河河閘之決，則其果於自信，抑且年邁自滿之失。

translations.literal: The Guiyou Zhangjialu and canal sluice breaches were his rash self-confidence and old-age complacency.
translations.idiomatic: The Guiyou Zhangjialu and sluice failures were rashness and age.

sentences.zh: 在本朝河臣中，即不能如靳輔，較齊蘇勒、嵇曾筠有過無不及。

translations.literal: Among river officials of this dynasty he cannot equal Jin Fu, but compared with Qi Sulei and Ji Cengyun he is not inferior.
translations.idiomatic: He fell short of Jin Fu but matched Qi Sulei and Ji Cengyun.

sentences.zh: 可與靳輔、齊蘇勒、嵇曾筠同祀，使後之司河務者知所激勸。

translations.literal: He may be worshipped with Jin Fu, Qi Sulei, and Ji Cengyun so later river officers know encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined with Jin Fu, Qi Sulei, and Ji Cengyun to encourage successors.

sentences.zh: 」二十三年，賜諡文定。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-third year posthumous name Wendi was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he received posthumous name Wendi.

sentences.zh: 御製懷舊詩，列五督臣中。

translations.literal: An imperial nostalgic poem listed him among five river directors.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial nostalgic poem named him among five great river directors.

sentences.zh: 命祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: He was ordered worshipped in the Worthies Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Worthies Shrine.

sentences.zh: 子高恆，高恆子高樸，皆坐事獲譴，自有傳。

translations.literal: Son Gao Heng and Gao Heng's son Gao Pu were both punished for offenses and have separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Son Gao Heng and grandson Gao Pu were punished—see their biographies.

sentences.zh: 上復錄高斌孫高杞授內務府郎中。

translations.literal: The emperor also enrolled Gao Bin's grandson Gao Qi as director of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Grandson Gao Qi was made an Imperial Household director.

sentences.zh: 從子高晉。

translations.literal: Nephew Gao Jin.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew was Gao Jin.

sentences.zh: 高晉，字昭德。

translations.literal: Gao Jin, courtesy name Zhaode.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin, courtesy name Zhaode.

sentences.zh: 父述明，涼州總兵。

translations.literal: His father Shuming was regional commander of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shuming was regional commander of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 高晉初授山東泗水知縣，累遷安徽布政使，兼江寧織造。

translations.literal: Gao Jin was first appointed magistrate of Sishui in Shandong, rose in succession to Anhui provincial treasurer, and also managed Nanjing weaving.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin began as Sishui magistrate, became Anhui treasurer, and ran Nanjing weaving.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，擢安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong he was promoted Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 he became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上南巡視河，命高晉協辦徐州黃河兩岸堤工。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, on the southern tour to inspect rivers, Gao Jin was ordered to assist on Xuzhou Yellow River dikes on both banks.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22, on the river inspection tour, he assisted Xuzhou Yellow River dikes.

sentences.zh: 高晉奏言：「鳳、潁災區諸工並舉，米價日昂，動工程銀三萬兩購米，尚慮不敷。

translations.literal: Gao Jin memorialized: "Feng and Ying disaster areas have all works underway together; rice prices rise daily; moving thirty thousand taels of project silver to buy rice still fears insufficiency."
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin said Feng and Ying disaster works and rising rice prices needed 30,000 taels for grain and still might not suffice.

sentences.zh: 上念淮徐海道諸工，截漕二十萬石平糶。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful of Huai-Xu-Hai works, diverted two hundred thousand shi of grain transport for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor diverted 200,000 shi of grain transport for relief sale on the Huai-Xu-Hai works.

sentences.zh: 請分五萬濟上江各工。

translations.literal: He asked fifty thousand divided to upper-Jiang works.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin asked fifty thousand for upper-Jiang works.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 工竟，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: When the work was done he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When done he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，遷江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was transferred Director-general of Jiangnan Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 he became Jiangnan river director-general.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「高、寶、興、泰積年被水，上命封南關、車邏等壩，於金灣壩下濬引河，洩水歸江，使洪澤湖、運河之水不致漫壩東注。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Gaobao, Xing, Tai have suffered flood for years; the emperor ordered Nanguan, Cheba, and other dams sealed, a diversion dredged below Jinwan Dam to discharge to the Yangtze, so Hongze and canal water would not spill east over the dams."
translations.idiomatic: Flooded Gaobao, Xing, and Tai had Nanguan and Cheba sealed and a Jinwan diversion to the Yangtze so Hongze would not spill east.

sentences.zh: 下河各縣支河汊港及田間積水，均匯入串場河，北至鹽城石、天妃等閘，出新洋港。

translations.literal: Lower-river counties' branch rivers, harbors, and field standing water all converged on the Chuanchang River, north to Yancheng Shi, Tianfei, and other sluices, out Xinyang Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Lower counties' branches and standing water fed the Chuanchang north to Yancheng and out Xinyang Harbor.

sentences.zh: 又自興化白駒、青龍、八社、大團等閘出鬥龍港，分二道歸海。

translations.literal: Also from Xinghua Baiju, Qinglong, Bashe, Datuan, and other sluices out Doulong Harbor, divided in two routes to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua sluices also sent water out Doulong Harbor in two sea routes.

sentences.zh: 惟下河形如釜底，積澇驟難消涸。

translations.literal: Only the lower river is shaped like a cauldron bottom; standing flood is hard to drain quickly.
translations.idiomatic: The lower river was cauldron-shaped; standing flood drained slowly.

sentences.zh: 請浚興化迤南丁溪、小梅二閘引河使出王家港，興化迤北上岡、北草堰、陳家衝三閘引河，使匯射陽湖，增二道歸海，俾數州縣積水節節流通，沮洳漸成沃壤。

translations.literal: He asked to dredge Dingxi and Xiaomei sluice diversions south of Xinghua to Wangjiagang, and Shanggang, Beicaoyan, and Chenjiachong sluice diversions north of Xinghua into Sheyang Lake, adding two sea routes, so standing water in several prefectures and counties flows step by step and marsh gradually becomes fertile soil.
translations.idiomatic: He asked Xinghua diversions north and south into Wangjiagang and Sheyang Lake so several counties' water would drain and marshes turn fertile.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，授內大臣，奏言：「運河歸江，邵伯以下舊設六閘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was appointed inner court minister and memorialized: "The canal returns to the Yangtze; below Shao Bo six sluices were formerly set."
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 he became inner minister and noted six sluices below Shao Bo on the canal to the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 自鹽河分流下注，請將六閘金門量為展寬。

translations.literal: Since the salt river divides flow, he asked the six sluices' golden gates be widened as measured.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the six sluices' gates widened as salt-river flow divided.

sentences.zh: 又鹽河舊設中、南、北各二閘，應留北二閘以濟鹽、運。

translations.literal: The salt river formerly had middle, south, and north two sluices each; the north two should remain to aid salt and transport.
translations.idiomatic: North salt-river sluices should stay for salt and grain transport.

sentences.zh: 南、中二閘過水遲滯，應添建石壩，接長土堤，酌挑引河，俾高、寶湖水歸江益暢。

translations.literal: South and middle sluices slow water; stone dams should be added, earthen dikes lengthened, and diversions dredged as needed so Gaobao lake water returns to the Yangtze more freely."
translations.idiomatic: South and middle sluices were slow; he asked stone dams, longer dikes, and diversions to free Gaobao water to the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 」二十八年，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-eighth year he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he was Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，奏言：「清口以上桃、宿等廳，專受黃水；

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he memorialized: "Above Qingkou, Tao, Su, and other bureaus receive only Yellow water;
translations.idiomatic: Above Qingkou, Tao and Su bureaus took only Yellow water;

sentences.zh: 清口東壩以下，淮、黃合流，至雲梯關迤東歸海。

translations.literal: below Qingkou east dam, Huai and Yellow join and run to the sea east of Yunti Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Below Qingkou east dam Huai and Yellow merged to the sea past Yunti Pass.

sentences.zh: 北岸五套、南岸陳家浦頂沖入溜，議培築舊堤。

translations.literal: Wutao on the north bank and Chenjiapu on the south take the head-on rush; strengthening old dikes was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Wutao north and Chenjiapu south took the head-on rush; old dikes were discussed.

sentences.zh: 臣以雲梯關外近海，與其築堤束水，不若於舊堤上首作斜長子堰，使水匯正河入海。

translations.literal: He held that outside Yunti Pass near the sea, rather than building dikes to confine water, slanted long subsidiary weirs on the old dike head should gather the main channel to the sea."
translations.idiomatic: Near the sea he preferred slanted subsidiary weirs on the old dike to send the main channel seaward rather than tight dikes.

sentences.zh: 」上均是之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 三十年，遷兩江總督，仍統理南河事務。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was transferred Liangjiang governor-general, still overseeing Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 he became Liangjiang governor-general, still over Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，按蘇州同知段成功縱僕擾民，高晉以成功方病，擬寬之，上責其袒庇。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, investigating Suzhou vice prefect Duan Chenggong for servants harassing the people, Gao Jin, because Chenggong was ill, proposed leniency; the emperor rebuked him for favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 he favored ill Vice Prefect Duan Chenggong and was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，署湖廣總督，兼攝荊州將軍事。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he acted as Huguang governor-general and also Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 33 he acted as Huguang governor-general and Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，回任，兼署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he returned to post and also acted as Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34 he returned and acted as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 上命採洋銅鑄錢，高晉請收小錢，並運雲南銅供鑄，費省於洋銅，上用其議。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered foreign copper for coinage; Gao Jin asked to collect small coins and transport Yunnan copper for casting, cheaper than foreign copper; the emperor adopted his plan.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed Yunnan copper and collecting small coins for minting—cheaper than foreign copper.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，兼署漕運總督，授文華殿大學士，兼禮部尚書，仍任總督如故。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he also acted as grain transport director-general, was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory, concurrently Minister of Rites, still governor-general as before.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 he also ran grain transport, became Grand Secretary of Literary Glory and Minister of Rites, still governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尋命同侍郎裘曰修、總督楊廷璋籌勘永定河工。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered with Vice Minister Qiu Yixiu and Governor-general Yang Tingzhang to plan Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he planned Yongding works with Qiu Yixiu and Yang Tingzhang.

sentences.zh: 事竟，還江南。

translations.literal: When done he returned to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: When done he returned to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 四十年，河東河道總督姚立德奏請以蜀山湖收蓄伏秋汛水，工部以舊例蜀山湖於十月後收蓄汶河清水議駁，上命高晉會勘。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year Eastern Rivers Director-general Yao Lide memorialized to use Shushan Lake to store spring and autumn flood water; the Board of Works rejected it citing old rule that Shushan stores Wen River clear water only after the tenth month; the emperor ordered Gao Jin to survey jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In year 40 Yao Lide proposed Shushan Lake for flood storage; the Board cited old rules; Gao Jin was sent to survey.

sentences.zh: 尋奏：「蜀山湖周六十五里，在汶河南、運河東，為第一水櫃。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "Shushan Lake circumference sixty-five li, south of the Wen River and east of the canal, is the foremost water cabinet."
translations.idiomatic: Shushan Lake—65 li around, south of Wen and east of canal—was the foremost water cabinet.

sentences.zh: 向定蓄水限九尺七八寸，請改以一丈一尺為率，兼蓄伏秋汛水。

translations.literal: The former storage limit was nine chi seven or eight cun; he asked to change the standard to one zhang one chi and also store spring and autumn flood water."
translations.idiomatic: He raised the storage limit from nine chi seven or eight cun to one zhang one chi and asked flood storage too.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，河督吳嗣爵奏黃河淤高，命高晉與總督薩載籌議。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year Director-general Wu Sijue memorialized that the Yellow River had silted high; Gao Jin was ordered with Governor-general Sazai to plan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 41 Wu Sijue said the Yellow had silted high; Gao Jin planned with Sazai.

sentences.zh: 請浚清口以內引河停淤，使清水暢出，與黃河匯流東注，並力剔沙，則黃河不濬自深，海口不疏自治。

translations.literal: He asked to dredge diversions within Qingkou so clear water flows freely, joins the Yellow and runs east, and together scours sand, then the Yellow will deepen without dredging and the estuary regulate without dredging."
translations.idiomatic: He asked Qingkou diversions dredged so clear water scoured sand with the Yellow and deepened the river naturally.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「此奏甚合機宜形勢，為治淮、黃一大關鍵。

translations.literal: " The emperor instructed: "This memorial fits the terrain and timing very well; it is a great key to governing Huai and Yellow."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor called it the key to governing Huai and Yellow.

sentences.zh: 屆時妥為之。

translations.literal: Do it properly when the time comes."
translations.idiomatic: Do it properly in season.

sentences.zh: 」是冬，入覲，上以高晉年七十，書榜以賜。

translations.literal: " That winter, entering audience, because Gao Jin was seventy the emperor wrote a plaque and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: That winter at audience, aged seventy, he received an imperial plaque.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，命赴浙江會巡撫王亶望相度海塘，又命赴河南堵築儀封漫口。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he was ordered to Zhejiang with Governor Wang Tanwang to survey seawalls, and to Henan to block the Yifeng breach.
translations.idiomatic: In year 43 he surveyed Zhejiang seawalls and blocked Yifeng breach in Henan.

sentences.zh: 秋，河決時和驛，高晉請議處，命寬之。

translations.literal: In autumn the river broke at Shihe Post; Gao Jin asked to be punished; the emperor was lenient.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn breach at Shihe Post; he asked punishment; the emperor was lenient.

sentences.zh: 冬，時和驛工竟。

translations.literal: In winter the Shihe Post work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: Winter work at Shihe finished.

sentences.zh: 儀封新修埽工蟄陷，部議奪官，仍命留任。

translations.literal: New revetment work at Yifeng collapsed; the ministry proposed stripping his office; he was still ordered to remain.
translations.idiomatic: Yifeng revetment failed; ministry proposed dismissal; he remained.

sentences.zh: 十二月，卒，賜祭葬，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he died; funeral rites were granted and posthumous name Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 he died with rites and posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 懷舊詩並列五督臣中。

translations.literal: The nostalgic poem listed him among five river directors.
translations.idiomatic: The nostalgic poem named him among five river directors.

sentences.zh: 子書麟、廣興，自有傳。

translations.literal: Sons Shulin and Guangxing have separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Sons Shulin and Guangxing have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 完顏偉，完顏即其氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wan Yan Wei; Wan Yan is his clan; a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Yan Wei, of the Wan Yan clan, was a Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，自內務府筆帖式累遷戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period, from Imperial Household clerk he rose in succession to Revenue Department vice director.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng he rose from Household clerk to Revenue vice director.

sentences.zh: 命往江南學習河務。

translations.literal: He was ordered to Jiangnan to study river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Jiangnan to study river affairs.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，授浙江海防道。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he was appointed Zhejiang coastal defense intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 he became Zhejiang coastal defense intendant.

sentences.zh: 調江南河務道，尋擢浙江按察使。

translations.literal: Transferred to Jiangnan river intendant, soon promoted Zhejiang surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Jiangnan river intendant, then Zhejiang surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 方建尖山壩工，巡撫盧焯奏以偉督工，歲賚銀五百。

translations.literal: While the Jianshan dam was being built, Governor Lu Chao memorialized that Wei supervise the work, with five hundred taels yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Building Jianshan dam, Governor Lu Chao had Wei supervise for 500 taels yearly.

sentences.zh: 六年，命為江南副總河，就擢河道總督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered Southern Rivers vice director-general and at once promoted river director-general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he became vice then Jiangnan river director-general.

sentences.zh: 高郵南關、五里、車邏三壩，值河、湖盛漲，洩水輒浸下河州縣民田。

translations.literal: Gaoyou Nanguan, Wuli, and Cheba three dams, when river and lake were high, discharge often flooded lower-river county fields.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoyou's Nanguan, Wuli, and Cheba dams flooded lower counties when lakes rose.

sentences.zh: 上命閉洪澤湖天然壩及三壩，不使水入下河。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Hongze's natural dam and the three dams closed so water would not enter the lower river.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor closed Hongze's natural dam and the three dams to spare the lower river.

sentences.zh: 知州沈光曾以上河濱湖灘地被水，議以濟運餘水由三壩減洩，並易芒稻河閘為壩，疏寶應、高郵、甘泉諸湖南注之路。

translations.literal: Prefect Shen Guangzeng, because upper-river lakeside beaches were flooded, proposed using surplus transport water discharged through the three dams and changing Mangdao sluice to a dam, dredging south-flow routes in Baoying, Gaoyou, Ganquan, and other lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Shen Guangzeng wanted surplus transport water through the three dams and Mangdao changed to a dam.

sentences.zh: 偉劾其擾亂河工，光曾坐奪官。

translations.literal: Wei impeached him for disturbing river works; Guangzeng was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Wei impeached him for disturbing works; Guangzeng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 初，上以黃河大溜逼清口，命循康熙舊跡，開陶莊引河，導使北注。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor, because the Yellow main current pressed Qingkou, ordered following Kangxi's old trace to open Taozhuang diversion to lead it north.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Qianlong ordered Taozhuang diversion opened like Kangxi to turn the Yellow north.

sentences.zh: 大學士鄂爾泰與河道總督高斌合勘，甫定議，會暴汛積淤，工遂停。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ortai and Director-general Gao Bin surveyed jointly; the plan was just settled when sudden flood silt stopped the work.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai and Gao Bin had just agreed when flood silt halted work.

sentences.zh: 高斌亦去任，復命偉相度。

translations.literal: Gao Bin also left office; Wei was again ordered to survey.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin left; Wei surveyed again.

sentences.zh: 偉議自清口迤西黃河南岸設木龍挑溜，使漸趨而北。

translations.literal: Wei proposed from west of Qingkou on the Yellow south bank to set wooden dragons to deflect the current gradually north.
translations.idiomatic: Wei proposed wooden deflectors west of Qingkou on the south bank to turn the current north.

sentences.zh: 七年，疏言：「淮源上游雨多水發，賈魯河盛漲，由渦達淮，匯於洪澤湖。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he memorialized: "The Huai source upstream had much rain and high water; the Jialu River rose greatly, reached the Huai through Wo, and converged on Hongze Lake."
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he reported heavy rains, Jialu flood through Wo into Hongze.

sentences.zh: 三石滾壩減歸高、寶、邵伯等湖，而古溝、東壩漫刷過水又自白馬湖來會，水勢益大。

translations.literal: The three stone rolling dams reduced water to Gaobao, Xing, Shao Bo, and other lakes, while Gugou and east dam overflow scour also joined from Baima Lake; the water force grew greater.
translations.idiomatic: Three stone rolling dams fed Gaobao and other lakes; Gugou and east-dam overflow and Baima Lake added force.

sentences.zh: 臣督築子堰捍禦，並開高郵老土壩及南關等三壩，水勢始定。

translations.literal: He supervised building subsidiary weirs to resist and opened Gaoyou old earthen dam and Nanguan and the other three dams; the water force then stabilized."
translations.idiomatic: He built subsidiary weirs and opened Gaoyou's old dam and the three sluices until water stabilized.

sentences.zh: 」上嘉之。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him.

sentences.zh: 是歲黃河亦盛漲，石林口減水過多，沛縣及山東魚台、滕、嶧諸縣皆被水。

translations.literal: That year the Yellow River also rose greatly; Shilinkou discharged too much; Peixian and Shandong Yutai, Teng, Yi, and other counties were all flooded.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yellow also rose; Shilinkou spilled; Peixian and Shandong counties flooded.

sentences.zh: 偉具疏請罪。

translations.literal: Wei fully memorialized asking guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Wei memorialized asking punishment.

sentences.zh: 御史吳煒劾偉用人不得當，偉疏辨，上不深責，調河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Censor Wu Wei impeached Wei for improper appointments; Wei memorialized in defense; the emperor did not blame deeply and transferred him Eastern Rivers director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wu Wei impeached his appointments; he was transferred east without deep blame.

sentences.zh: 九年，奏言：「山東歷年被水，由於上游散漫，下游梗阻。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he memorialized: "Shandong suffers flood yearly because upstream is scattered and downstream blocked."
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he said Shandong flooded because upstream scattered and downstream blocked.

sentences.zh: 運河東接汶、泗、沂、濟諸水，洩入微山、蜀山、南旺、馬踏諸湖；

translations.literal: The canal east joins Wen, Si, Yi, and Ji waters, discharging into Weishan, Shushan, Nanwang, Mata, and other lakes;
translations.idiomatic: The canal east took Wen, Si, Yi, and Ji into Weishan, Shushan, Nanwang, and other lakes;

sentences.zh: 北接漳、衛二水，洩入鹽河、徒駭、馬頰、鉤盤諸河。

translations.literal: north joins Zhang and Wei waters, discharging into the salt river, Tuhai, Majia, Goupan, and other rivers.
translations.idiomatic: north it took Zhang and Wei into salt river, Tuhai, Majia, Goupan, and others.

sentences.zh: 遇伏秋異漲，宣洩不及，應於運河內增閘壩以分其勢，疏下河以暢其流。

translations.literal: When spring and autumn floods are abnormal, discharge cannot keep up; sluices and dams should be added on the canal to divide force and the lower river dredged to ease flow.
translations.idiomatic: Abnormal floods needed more canal sluices and lower-river dredging.

sentences.zh: 其經由各州縣，凡溝渠淤狹者濬之，堤堰殘缺者修之。

translations.literal: In each prefecture and county passed through, whatever ditches are silted narrow should be dredged and whatever dikes are broken should be repaired."
translations.idiomatic: Every county's ditches and dikes should be dredged and repaired.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Reported approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，以母老乞回京，有旨慰留。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, his mother being old, he begged to return to the capital; an edict urged him to stay.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 his mother was old; he begged to return; the emperor urged him to stay.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he became Left Vice Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he died.

sentences.zh: 顧琮，字用方，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，尚書顧八代孫。

translations.literal: Gu Cong, courtesy name Yongfang, of the Irgen Gioro clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, grandson of Minister Gu Badai.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong, courtesy name Yongfang, Irgen Gioro, Bordered Yellow Banner, was Minister Gu Badai's grandson.

sentences.zh: 父顧儼，歷官副都統。

translations.literal: His father Gu Yan rose to vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gu Yan became vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 顧琮，以監生錄入算學館，修算法諸書，書成議敘。

translations.literal: Gu Cong, entered the Mathematics Institute as a supervised student, compiled books on calculation methods; when finished merit was deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong entered the Mathematics Institute, compiled calculation texts, and earned merit deliberation.

sentences.zh: 康熙六十一年，授吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year of Kangxi he was appointed Revenue Department vice director.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 61 he became Revenue vice director.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，授戶部郎中，遷御史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng he was appointed Revenue Department bureau director, then transferred censor.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 he became Revenue bureau director, then censor.

sentences.zh: 四年，巡視長蘆鹽政。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he inspected Changlu salt administration.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he inspected Changlu salt.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he became Director of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 九年，授霸州營田使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Bazhou agricultural colony commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he became Bazhou agricultural colony commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一年，協理直隸總河，遷太常寺卿，署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he assisted in managing Zhili rivers, was transferred Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and acted as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he assisted Zhili rivers, became Sacrifices director, acted as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尋授直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Zhili river director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Zhili river director-general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，奏報：「永定河口深通，上流始得暢注入淀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he reported: "The Yongding estuary is deep and clear; upstream can pour freely into the ponds."
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he reported the Yongding mouth clear and upstream flowing freely into the ponds.

sentences.zh: 近因淤，議濬引河，自然開刷，不勞民力，號為天賜引河。

translations.literal: Recently because of silt, a diversion was discussed for dredging; it opened naturally without labor, called the Heaven-bestowed diversion."
translations.idiomatic: Silt had blocked it until a "Heaven-bestowed" diversion opened naturally.

sentences.zh: 」上令報祀。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered sacrifice reported.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered sacrifice reported.

sentences.zh: 疏請更定管河廳汛，增設員缺，下部議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized to fix river bureau and flood-season posts and add offices; sent to ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He fixed river posts and added offices—all implemented.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he acted as Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he acted as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂回旗。

translations.literal: His father died; he returned to the banner for mourning.
translations.idiomatic: His father died; he mourned in the banner.

sentences.zh: 二年，命協辦吏部尚書事。

translations.literal: In the second year he was ordered to assist as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he assisted as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 永定河決，命偕總督李衛督修。

translations.literal: The Yongding River broke; he was ordered with Governor-general Li Wei to supervise repair.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding broke; he repaired it with Li Wei.

sentences.zh: 旋署河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as river director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he acted as river director-general.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，改授硃藻，命協同辦理。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Zhu Zao was appointed; he was ordered to assist jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 3 Zhu Zao was appointed; Gu Cong assisted.

sentences.zh: 奏畿輔西南諸水匯於東西兩淀，淤墊漫溢為患。

translations.literal: He memorialized that southwest capital-region waters converge on east and west ponds; silt and overflow are disasters.
translations.idiomatic: Capital southwest waters converged on east and west ponds, silting and flooding.

sentences.zh: 請設垡船撈泥，以三角淀通判、清河同知司其事。

translations.literal: He asked scoop boats to dredge mud, the Sanjiao Pond vice intendant and Qinghe vice intendant to manage it.
translations.idiomatic: He asked scoop boats dredging mud under Sanjiao Pond and Qinghe intendants.

sentences.zh: 藻罷去，复授河道總督。

translations.literal: Zao was dismissed; he was again appointed river director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zao left; Gu Cong was river director-general again.

sentences.zh: 五年，濬青縣興濟、滄州捷地兩減河，疏陳善後諸事，請疏海口，築遙堤，多設涵洞。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he dredged the two overflow rivers at Xingji in Qingxian and Jiedi in Cangzhou, memorialized follow-up matters, and asked to dredge the estuary, build setback dikes, and add many culverts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he dredged Xingji and Jiedi overflow rivers and asked estuary dredging, setback dikes, and culverts.

sentences.zh: 六年，請改定子牙河管河官制。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he asked to revise Ziya River river-official regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he revised Ziya River officials' regulations.

sentences.zh: 尋以裁缺回京。

translations.literal: Soon, posts being cut, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Soon posts were cut and he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是年，授漕運總督。

translations.literal: That year he was appointed grain transport director-general.
translations.idiomatic: That year he became grain transport director-general.

sentences.zh: 七年，奏言：「清江以上，運河兩岸，向來只知束水濟運，未知藉水灌田，坐聽萬頃源泉，未收涓滴之利。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he memorialized: "Above Qingjiang on both canal banks, they only knew confining water for transport and did not know using water to irrigate fields, sitting by while ten thousand qing of springs brought not a drop's benefit."
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he said above Qingjiang people only confined canal water for transport, not irrigation.

sentences.zh: 同此田畝，淮南、淮北，腴瘠相懸。

translations.literal: The same fields: south and north of the Huai, fertile and poor differ greatly.
translations.idiomatic: South and north Huai fields of the same size differed sharply in yield.

sentences.zh: 或疑運河洩水，於濟運有妨。

translations.literal: Some fear canal discharge harms transport.
translations.idiomatic: Some feared discharge would harm transport.

sentences.zh: 不知漕艘道經淮、徐，五月上旬即可過竣。

translations.literal: They do not know grain boats pass Huai and Xu and can finish by early fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Grain boats passed Huai and Xu by early fifth month.

sentences.zh: 稻田須水，正在夏秋間。

translations.literal: Rice fields need water precisely in summer and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Rice needed water in summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 若屆時始行宣導，是祗借閉蓄之水為灌溉之資，於漕運初無所妨。

translations.literal: If guidance begins only then, it only uses stored closed water for irrigation and at first does not harm transport.
translations.idiomatic: Guidance then used stored water for irrigation without harming transport.

sentences.zh: 況清江左右所建涵洞，成效彰彰。

translations.literal: Moreover the culverts built left and right of Qingjiang have shown clear results.
translations.idiomatic: Culverts beside Qingjiang had already proved effective.

sentences.zh: 推此仿行，萬無疑慮。

translations.literal: Extending this example, there is no doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Following that example, he said, left no real doubt.

sentences.zh: 請特遣大臣總理相度，會同督、撫、河臣詳酌興工。

translations.literal: He asked that a minister be specially dispatched to oversee survey, joining governors-general, governors, and river officials to deliberate and begin work.
translations.idiomatic: He asked a senior minister survey with governors and river officials.

sentences.zh: 」議未及行。

translations.literal: " Discussion had not yet been implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was not yet carried out.

sentences.zh: 八年，以督運詣京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, supervising transport, he went to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he went to Beijing supervising transport.

sentences.zh: 入對，請行限田，上斥其擾民。

translations.literal: Entering audience he asked to implement land limits; the emperor rebuked him for troubling the people.
translations.idiomatic: At audience he proposed land limits; the emperor called it harassment.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，疏請於馬莊集、曹家店各建石閘，束上游之水，並將駱馬湖入運處改在皁河以上車頭，建閘挑渠，引水濟運。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year he memorialized to build stone sluices at Mazhuangji and Caojiadian each to confine upstream water, and change Luoma Lake's entry to the canal above Zaohe to Chetou, building sluices and channels to lead water for transport.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 of year 10 he asked stone sluices at Mazhuangji and Caojiadian and Luoma entry moved above Zaohe.

translations.literal: After Shizi River bamboo-cage dam opened, Yellow water rushed and cut across the canal; grain boats hauling upstream were in difficulty.
translations.idiomatic: After Shizi River's bamboo dam opened, Yellow water blocked the canal and hindered grain boats.

sentences.zh: 當於竹谿壩下束黃壩迤東接堤堵截，別於蘇家閘南濬河越黃入運，從之。

translations.literal: Below Zhuxi Dam a Yellow-confining dam should be built east with linked dikes to block; separately south of Sujia sluice dredge a canal crossing Yellow into the canal; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Below Zhuxi he asked a Yellow-blocking dam and a canal south of Sujia sluice crossing Yellow into the canal—approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he acted as Jiangnan river director-general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he acted as Jiangnan river director-general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，命偕大學士高斌按浙江巡撫常安貪婪狀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was ordered with Grand Secretary Gao Bin to investigate Zhejiang Governor Chang An's greed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he and Gao Bin investigated Chang An's graft in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 坐未窮治，奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: For not pursuing to the end he was stripped of office but ordered to remain.
translations.idiomatic: For not pressing the case he was stripped yet kept in post.

sentences.zh: 尋調河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred Eastern Rivers director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became Eastern Rivers director-general.

sentences.zh: 十七年，疏言：「運河堤未設堡房。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he memorialized: "Canal dikes have no blockhouse posts."
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 he said canal dikes lacked blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 請視黃河例，每二里建堡房，都計四百餘座。

translations.literal: He asked following the Yellow River precedent to build a blockhouse every two li, more than four hundred in all."
translations.idiomatic: He asked a blockhouse every two li—400-odd total.

sentences.zh: 」十九年，坐江南總河任內浮費工銀，奪官。

translations.literal: " In the nineteenth year, for inflated project silver as Jiangnan director-general, he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he was stripped for inflated project silver as Jiangnan director.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he died.

sentences.zh: 顧琮內行嚴正，嘗入對，值旱多風，世宗以為憂。

translations.literal: Gu Cong's private conduct was strict and upright; once entering audience during drought with much wind, Emperor Shizong was troubled.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong was upright; once in drought and wind Yongzheng was troubled.

sentences.zh: 顧琮引洪範謂「蒙恆風若，慮臣或蔽君」，上為之動容。

translations.literal: Gu Cong cited the Hongfan saying "constant wind like mist—fearing ministers may screen the ruler"; the emperor was moved.
translations.idiomatic: He cited the Hongfan on wind and screening ministers; the emperor was moved.

sentences.zh: 世宗崩，顧琮方喪偶，逾三年乃續娶。

translations.literal: When Shizong died Gu Cong had just lost his wife; only after more than three years did he remarry.
translations.idiomatic: After Yongzheng died he had lost his wife and remarried only after three years.

sentences.zh: 方苞以為合禮。

translations.literal: Fang Bao held it accorded with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Bao called it proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 白鍾山，字毓秀，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Bai Zhongshan, courtesy name Yuxiu, a Han bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Zhongshan, courtesy name Yuxiu, was a Plain Blue Banner Han bannerman.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，自戶部筆帖式遷江南山清里河同知。

translations.idiomatic: In early Yongzheng he rose from Revenue clerk to Shanqingli River vice intendant.

sentences.zh: 累擢江蘇布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Jiangsu provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He became Jiangsu provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 奏：「狼山、蘇松二鎮駐地距蘇州俱遠，軍糈輓運維艱，請就所駐及附近州縣配給。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Langshan and Susong garrisons are both far from Suzhou; military grain transport is hard; he asked distribution from stations and nearby prefectures and counties."
translations.idiomatic: He asked military grain supplied near Langshan and Susong garrisons.

sentences.zh: 崇明孤懸海外，地不產米，請由江、廣採運，撥萬石貯崇明倉，備平糶。

translations.literal: Chongming stands alone overseas and produces no rice; he asked collection from Jiang and Guang, ten thousand shi stored in Chongming granary for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming, riceless and isolated, should get 10,000 shi from Jiang and Guang for relief stores.

sentences.zh: 海濱漲出沙洲，民人佔居，當築土墩以避潮患。

translations.literal: On the seashore sand bars emerged and people occupied them; earthen mounds should be built to avoid tide peril.
translations.idiomatic: New tidal bars needed earth mounds against tide damage.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was appointed Southern Rivers vice director-general, soon promoted Eastern Rivers director-general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he became Southern Rivers vice director, then Eastern Rivers director-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，奏：「河標兵駐濟寧，無倉儲，每稱貸貴糴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he memorialized: "River-banner troops are stationed at Jining without granaries; they often borrow and buy dear."
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he said river troops at Jining lacked granaries and paid dear for grain.

sentences.zh: 請以生息銀二千七百有奇買穀四千石，設倉存貯，春借秋收。

translations.literal: He asked interest silver of more than 2,700 to buy four thousand shi of grain, set up a granary, lend in spring and collect in autumn.
translations.idiomatic: He asked 2,700-odd taels interest silver to buy 4,000 shi for a lend-in-spring granary.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「豫東河防，水落時，當堵塞支河。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Eastern Henan river defense: when water falls, branch rivers should be blocked."
translations.idiomatic: When water fell, Eastern Henan branch rivers should be blocked.

sentences.zh: 伏秋水漲，購料募夫，每慮不及。

translations.literal: When spring and autumn floods rise, buying materials and hiring labor is often feared insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Flood season materials and labor were often insufficient.

sentences.zh: 請發河南、山東司庫銀分存鄭州及武陟、封丘、曹、單諸縣，永遠貯備。

translations.literal: He asked Henan and Shandong treasury silver divided and stored at Zhengzhou, Wuzhi, Fengqiu, Cao, Shan, and other counties for permanent reserve.
translations.idiomatic: He asked treasury silver stored permanently at Zhengzhou, Wuzhi, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All approved.

translations.idiomatic: The Zhang once reached the sea from Zhili; Kangxi 45 sent it into the Wei; the old course silted.

translations.literal: Later at Shaomaying in Dezhou a rolling dam was built and a diversion opened to discharge Wei water through Goupan River to the old Yellow River estuary.
translations.idiomatic: Later Dezhou's Shaomaying rolling dam spilled Wei water through Goupan to the old Yellow estuary.

sentences.zh: 然漳、衛二水隨時淤塞，虛糜帑金。

translations.literal: Yet Zhang and Wei waters silt at any time, wasting treasury funds.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang and Wei still silted, wasting funds.

sentences.zh: 漳水舊有正河、支河，應擇易浚者復其故道。

translations.literal: The Zhang formerly had main and branch rivers; the easier to dredge should restore the old course.
translations.idiomatic: Main and branch Zhang courses should be restored where easy to dredge.

sentences.zh: 於館陶建閘，衛水大，聽漳入海以防漲；

translations.literal: Build a sluice at Guantao; when Wei water is great, let Zhang enter the sea against flood;
translations.idiomatic: At Guantao build a sluice: when Wei is high, send Zhang to the sea;
