translations.literal: when Wei water is small, divide Zhang into Wei to aid transport."
translations.idiomatic: when Wei is low, divide Zhang into Wei for transport.

sentences.zh: 」奏入，命大學士鄂爾泰詳議，議在丘縣東和爾寨村承漳河北折之勢，接開十餘裡，至漳洞村入舊河；

translations.literal: " The memorial entered; Grand Secretary Ortai was ordered to deliberate in detail; the plan was at Heerzhai Village east of Qiu County to take the Zhang north-bending force, open more than ten li to Zhangdong Village into the old river;
translations.idiomatic: Ortai planned reopening the Zhang at Heerzhai east of Qiu County into the old river;

sentences.zh: 因於新河東流入衛處建閘，以時啟閉，上從之。

translations.literal: therefore at where the new river east enters Wei build a sluice to open and close as needed; the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: a sluice where the new channel entered Wei would open and close as needed—approved.

sentences.zh: 時漕運總督補熙請造十丈大船，運河當以水深四尺為則。

translations.literal: At that time Grain Transport Director-general Buxi asked to build hundred-zhang large ships; the canal should take four chi water depth as standard.
translations.idiomatic: Buxi asked hundred-zhang ships and a four-chi canal standard.

sentences.zh: 白鍾山謂：「徬河無源之水，雨至而後泉旺，泉旺而後河盈。

translations.literal: Bai Zhongshan said: "Side sluices are sourceless water; only after rain do springs flourish, and only after springs flourish does the river fill."
translations.idiomatic: Bai said side sluices had no source—rain first, then springs, then depth.

sentences.zh: 上徬閉、下徬啟，則下徬倍深，上徬倍淺。

translations.literal: Upper side closed and lower side open, then the lower is doubly deep and the upper doubly shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Close the upper side sluice and the lower doubles in depth while the upper shallows.

sentences.zh: 各徬相距遠近不均，水近者深，則遠者必淺。

translations.literal: Each sluice's distance is uneven; where water is near it is deep, then far must be shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Uneven spacing meant near sluices deep and far ones shallow.

sentences.zh: 以人役水，以水送舟，必不能均深四尺。

translations.literal: Using men to command water and water to carry boats, uniform four-chi depth certainly cannot be achieved."
translations.idiomatic: Men cannot force uniform four-chi depth on such water.

sentences.zh: 」侍郎趙殿最又請於館陶、臨清各立衛河水則，白鍾山謂：「尺寸不足，將衛輝民田渠徬盡閉，致妨灌溉，事既難行，尺寸既足，將官渠官徬盡閉，來源頓息。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zhao Dianzui also asked water gauges at Guantao and Linqing; Bai Zhongshan said: "If the measure is insufficient, Weihui civilian field sluices will all be closed and irrigation harmed—hard to implement; if sufficient, official channels and sluices will all be closed and the source suddenly cease."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dianzui wanted Wei gauges; Bai said they would either starve fields or dry the canal.

sentences.zh: 下流已逝，運河之水亦立見消涸。

translations.literal: Downstream already gone, canal water will at once be seen to dry up.
translations.idiomatic: Once downstream failed, the canal would dry at once.

sentences.zh: 二者均屬非計。

translations.literal: Both are wrong plans."
translations.idiomatic: Both plans were wrong.

sentences.zh: 」議並寢。

translations.literal: " Discussion was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Discussion was dropped.

sentences.zh: 八年，調江南河道總督，疏言：「石林口堵築堅固，大溜直趨下流。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred Jiangnan river director-general and memorialized: "Shilinkou blocking is solid; the main current runs straight downstream."
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, Jiangnan director, he said Shilinkou was solid and the main current ran downstream.

sentences.zh: 黃村、韓家塘等處新築子堰，恐不足抵禦，於對岸濬引河，導溜南注，並加厚子堰，派兵駐防。

translations.literal: New subsidiary weirs at Huangcun, Hanjiatang, and elsewhere fear insufficient to resist; on the opposite bank dredge a diversion to lead the current south, and also thicken subsidiary weirs and assign troops to garrison."
translations.idiomatic: He feared new weirs at Huangcun and Hanjiatang were weak and asked opposite-bank diversions and thicker weirs.

sentences.zh: 」又奏言：「葦蕩左右兩營，歲輸柴二百二十五萬束。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Reed-marsh left and right camps yearly deliver 2.25 million bundles of fuel."
translations.idiomatic: Reed camps delivered 2.25 million fuel bundles yearly.

sentences.zh: 積久生弊，輪運不齊。

translations.literal: Long accumulation breeds abuses; rotation delivery is uneven.
translations.idiomatic: Long practice bred abuse and uneven delivery.

sentences.zh: 請禁兵民雜採，定採葦期限，濬運柴溝渠，編柴船幫號。

translations.literal: He asked to forbid soldiers and civilians mixed cutting, fix reed-cutting seasons, dredge transport fuel channels, and organize fuel boat teams."
translations.idiomatic: He asked regulated cutting seasons, dredged channels, and organized fuel boats.

sentences.zh: 」皆允行。

translations.literal: " All approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，御史楊開鼎劾：「白鍾山出納慳吝，任情駁減，用損工偷，縱僕役婪索。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Censor Yang Kaiding impeached: "Bai Zhongshan is stingy in receipts and payments, arbitrarily reduces at will, uses funds to cheat works, and indulges servants in extortion."
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yang Kaiding accused Bai of stinginess, arbitrary cuts, and servant extortion.

sentences.zh: 陳家浦決七百餘丈，止稱二十餘丈。

translations.literal: Chenjiapu breach was more than seven hundred zhang; he reported only twenty-odd zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Chenjiapu's breach was 700-odd zhang; he reported only 20-odd.

sentences.zh: 興築延緩，阜寧、鹽城二縣受其害。

translations.literal: Construction was delayed; Funing and Yancheng two counties suffered harm."
translations.idiomatic: Delayed work harmed Funing and Yancheng.

sentences.zh: 」命高斌會尹繼善按治，以開鼎從。

translations.literal: " He was ordered to join Gao Bin and Yin Jishan in investigation; Kaiding was found at fault.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin and Yin Jishan investigated; Kaiding was faulted.

sentences.zh: 尋覆奏駁減、婪索無實據，惟陳家浦漫口沖刷，貽害累民。

translations.literal: Soon the review memorialized that reduction and extortion had no factual basis, only that Chenjiapu overflow scour harmed the people cumulatively.
translations.idiomatic: Review found no extortion, only Chenjiapu scour harming people.

sentences.zh: 上召白鍾山詣京師，奪官，效力河工。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Bai Zhongshan to the capital, stripped his office, and ordered him to serve on river works.
translations.idiomatic: Bai was summoned, stripped, and sent to river works.

sentences.zh: 總河顧琮复論白鍾山措處失當，上命籍其貲逾十萬以償。

translations.literal: Director-general Gu Cong again discussed Bai Zhongshan's improper measures; the emperor ordered his property over one hundred thousand registered for compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong blamed Bai's measures; over 100,000 taels of his property was seized for compensation.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授永定河道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Yongding River intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he became Yongding River intendant.

sentences.zh: 十八年，河決張家路，命從尚書舒赫德往勘。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the river broke at Zhangjialu; he was ordered to join Minister Shuhede in survey.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Zhangjialu broke; he surveyed with Shuhede.

sentences.zh: 旋命以按察使銜協辦南河事。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered with surveillance commissioner rank to assist Southern Rivers affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he assisted Southern Rivers as surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十九年，复授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was again appointed Eastern Rivers director-general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he was Eastern Rivers director-general again.

sentences.zh: 二十年，署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he acted as Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he acted as Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 請罷孔氏世襲曲阜知縣，上命改授世襲六品官。

translations.literal: He asked to abolish the Kong clan's hereditary Qufu magistracy; the emperor ordered instead a hereditary sixth-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to end the Kong hereditary Qufu magistracy; the emperor made it a hereditary sixth-rank post.

sentences.zh: 尋奏濟寧以南積水未消，請緩開汶河大壩，疏濬下游河道。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized that south of Jining standing flood had not drained; he asked to delay opening the Wen River great dam and dredge downstream channels.
translations.idiomatic: Standing flood south of Jining led him to delay opening the Wen great dam and dredge downstream.

sentences.zh: 上命白鍾山往勘南河，文武各官聽調遣。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Bai Zhongshan to survey Southern Rivers; civil and military officials were to obey his orders.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong sent Bai to survey Southern Rivers with full authority.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，調江南河道總督，疏言：「自河決張家路，沙停河淤，下流不暢，南高北洼。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred Jiangnan river director-general and memorialized: "Since Zhangjialu broke, sand settled and the river silted; downstream was not clear; south high north low."
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 he said since Zhangjialu the river had silted, south high north low.

sentences.zh: 迨孫家集復決，河底益高。

translations.literal: When Sunjiaji broke again the river bed grew still higher.
translations.idiomatic: Sunjiaji's breach raised the bed further.

sentences.zh: 黃河受病，率由水勢側注北岸，沖刷溝槽。

translations.literal: Yellow River illness mostly comes from the current slanting north, scouring gullies.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow River ills came from current slanting north and scouring gullies.

sentences.zh: 惟有南北分籌，南宜疏，北宜築。

translations.literal: Only north and south must be planned separately: south should be dredged, north should be built.
translations.idiomatic: South needed dredging, north building.

sentences.zh: 築則支河不致奪溜，疏則稍分有餘之水勢，庶徐州得以少安。

translations.literal: Building then branch rivers will not seize the current; dredging then slightly divides surplus water force; perhaps Xuzhou can be somewhat at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Building blocked branch seizures; dredging divided force—Xuzhou might rest easier.

sentences.zh: 臣與河臣張師載商榷，以為南岸長灘較北岸更險，必於橫亙處濬引河，導溜歸中，岸堤益加高厚。

translations.literal: He and river official Zhang Shizai discussed that the south bank long beach is more dangerous than the north; at the cross bar a diversion must be dredged to lead the current to center and bank dikes further raised and thickened.
translations.idiomatic: He and Zhang Shizai said the south long beach was worse—dredge a cross-bar diversion and raise dikes.

sentences.zh: 北岸無堤，漫水如梁家馬路、徐家莊等處支河數十道，及黃家莊、郭家堂等處漫槽矮灘，宜築土壩。

translations.literal: North bank without dikes, overflow like Liangjia Malu and Xujiazhuang branch rivers by the dozens, and Huangjiazhuang, Guojiatang overflow gullies and low bars should have earthen dams.
translations.idiomatic: North bank overflows at Liangjia Malu, Xujiazhuang, Huangjiazhuang, and Guojiatang needed earthen dams.

sentences.zh: 水平則收束以刷正河，水漲則平漫平消，不至衝槽奪溜。

translations.literal: When level, confine to scour the main river; when high, spread flat and dissipate flatly, not reaching gully scour and current seizure.
translations.idiomatic: Level water should scour the main channel; floods should spread flat without seizing branches.

sentences.zh: 並於孫家集培堤增壩，以為重障。

translations.literal: Also at Sunjiaji strengthen dikes and add dams as a heavy barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Sunjiaji also needed stronger dikes and dams as a barrier.

sentences.zh: 駱馬湖北受蒙陰山水，西受微山湖水，其尾閭在六塘河。

translations.literal: Luoma Lake north receives Mengyin mountain water, west receives Weishan Lake water; its tail outlet is on the Liutang River.
translations.idiomatic: Luoma Lake took Mengyin and Weishan waters; its tail was the Liutang River.

sentences.zh: 上游湖堤在在殘缺，亟應修補捍防。

translations.literal: Upstream lake dikes are everywhere broken; urgent repair and defense are needed."
translations.idiomatic: Upstream lake dikes were broken and needed urgent repair.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All approved.

sentences.zh: 荊山橋工竟，議敘。

translations.literal: Jingshan Bridge work was done; merit was deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: Jingshan Bridge work finished; merit was deliberated.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「寧夏上游河水陡漲，急報下游防範。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Ningxia upstream river water rose sharply; urgently report downstream to guard."
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia floods needed urgent downstream warning.

sentences.zh: 正陽關為淮水上下關鍵，應仿寧夏水報法，派員專司其事。

translations.literal: Zhengyang Pass is the key to Huai water up and down; the Ningxia water-report method should be copied and an officer assigned solely to it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyang Pass needed Ningxia-style flood reporting.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「上江諸水皆歸安河以達洪澤湖。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Upper Jiang waters all return to An River to reach Hongze Lake."
translations.idiomatic: Upper Jiang waters all reached Hongze through An River.

sentences.zh: 安河間段淤淺，連年水患由此。

translations.literal: An River sections are silted shallow; yearly water disasters come from this.
translations.idiomatic: Silted An River sections caused yearly floods.

sentences.zh: 宜多募漁船，伐蘆撈泥，俾尾閭一通，上游皆有去路。

translations.literal: Many fishing boats should be hired to cut reeds and scoop mud so the tail outlet is clear and upstream all has an outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Hire fishing boats to dredge reeds and mud so upstream had outlets.

sentences.zh: 又歸仁堤下舊有涵洞，穿鮑家河以達安河，久經湮塞。

translations.literal: Also under Guiren dike were old culverts through Baojia River to An River, long blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Old Guiren culverts to Baojia and An rivers were long blocked.

sentences.zh: 擬開浚分林子河一支，則安河進水之地亦有所分，患可漸減。

translations.literal: Plan to dredge Fenlinzi River branch so An River intake also has division; the peril can gradually lessen."
translations.idiomatic: Dredging Fenlinzi branch would ease An River intake.

sentences.zh: 」報聞。

translations.literal: " Reported received.
translations.idiomatic: Reported received.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he was Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，贈太子太保，賜祭葬，諡莊恪。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with funeral rites and posthumous name Zhuangke.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 he died, posthumously Grand Guardian with posthumous name Zhuangke.

sentences.zh: 論曰：自靳輔治河、淮，繼其後者，疏濬修築，守成法惟謹。

translations.literal: The critique says: From Jin Fu governing the rivers and Huai, those who followed dredged, built, and guarded established methods with care.
translations.idiomatic: The critique: after Jin Fu governed river and Huai, successors dredged and built by careful precedent.

sentences.zh: 世宗朝，齊蘇勒最著，嵇曾筠、高斌皆仍世繼業，與靳輔同祠河上，有功德於民，克應祭法。

translations.literal: In Emperor Shizong's court Qi Sulei was most notable; Ji Cengyun and Gao Bin both continued the family profession, worshipped with Jin Fu on the river, had merit for the people, and fit the sacrifices law.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng's court Qi Sulei stood out; Ji Cengyun and Gao Bin continued the line and were enshrined with Jin Fu.

sentences.zh: 完顏偉、顧琮、白鍾山隨事補苴，不負當官之責。

translations.literal: Wan Yan Wei, Gu Cong, and Bai Zhongshan patched matters as they arose and did not fail the duty of office.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Yan Wei, Gu Cong, and Bai Zhongshan patched gaps and did their duty.

sentences.zh: 高斌任事二十年，疏毛家鋪引河，排眾議行之，民蒙其利。

translations.literal: Gao Bin served twenty years, dredged Maojiapu diversion, overrode crowd opinion to implement it, and the people received its benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin served twenty years, opened Maojiapu diversion against opposition, and the people gained.

sentences.zh: 奪淮之役，縛赴工次待決。

translations.literal: In the campaign seizing the Huai he was bound to the worksite awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: When the Huai was seized he was bound at the works awaiting execution.

sentences.zh: 雷霆不測之威，赫矣哉！

translations.literal: The unpredictable awesome might of thunder—how splendid!
translations.idiomatic: How terrible and splendid the unpredictable thunder of imperial wrath!
